Introduction About DOLO 650MG TABLET

Dolo 650 Tablet contains 650 mg of paracetamol (also known as acetaminophen), a trusted active ingredient widely recognized for effectively providing relief from mild to moderate pain and helping to reduce elevated body temperature safely. It is suitable for adults and children above 12 years under medical guidance. Dolo 650 Tablet works by blocking the release of specific chemical messengers in the brain responsible for sensations of pain and fever, making it a reliable choice to ease discomfort from headaches, migraines, toothaches, sore throats, menstrual pains, arthritis-related aches, muscle soreness, and symptoms associated with the common cold.

Dolo 650 Tablet has been widely used, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, as a trusted paracetamol based medication to help provide relief from pain and fever. It is important to take Dolo 650 Tablet regularly as per the doctor’s instructions, ideally with food to minimize the risk of stomach upset. This medication can be taken alone or alongside other prescribed managements. However, it is crucial not to consume more than four doses within 24 hours, ensuring a minimum gap of at least four hours between consecutive doses. Prolonged use beyond the recommended duration should be avoided to maintain safety and effectiveness.

Generally, Dolo 650 Tablet is well tolerated, with side effects being uncommon. however, some individuals may experience temporary stomach pain, nausea, or vomiting. If any of these effects persist or become bothersome, it is important to consult a healthcare professional for advice.

Dolo 650 Tablet is generally considered safe but may not be suitable for everyone. Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions, allergies to the medication, or are taking other drugs, as these factors may influence the appropriate dose or suitability. It is advisable to use the lowest effective dose for the shortest recommended duration. This medication is commonly preferred as a pain relief option during pregnancy and breastfeeding, subject to medical guidance.

How DOLO 650MG TABLET Works

How Dolo 650 Tablet Works in the Body

Dolo 650 Tablet contains paracetamol, which acts centrally in the brain to provide relief by blocking the release of chemicals involved in signaling pain and regulating body temperature, leading to effective management of discomfort and fever.

Understanding Paracetamol’s Mechanism of Action

Paracetamol works primarily by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins in the brain, which are responsible for transmitting pain and triggering fever responses, thereby helping to reduce pain sensations and lower elevated temperatures safely.

Role of Prostaglandins in Pain and Fever

Prostaglandins are chemical messengers released at sites of injury or infection that promote inflammation, pain, and fever. By reducing prostaglandin production, Dolo 650 Tablet helps moderate these symptoms, aiding in symptom relief.

How Dolo 650 Helps Manage Pain and Temperature

Dolo 650 helps control pain by interrupting pain signal pathways in the central nervous system and supports temperature regulation through its action on the hypothalamic heat-regulating center, promoting fever reduction and patient comfort.

Central Nervous System Effects of Paracetamol

Paracetamol influences the central nervous system by blocking pain signals and modulating neurotransmitters involved in pain perception and temperature control, resulting in analgesic and antipyretic effects without significant anti-inflammatory activity.

What Happens After Taking Dolo 650?

After ingestion, Dolo 650 is absorbed and begins to act within 30 to 60 minutes, providing relief from pain and fever that typically lasts 4 to 6 hours, allowing patients to regain comfort and resume daily activities effectively.

How to use DOLO 650MG TABLET

Recommended Dosage for Dolo 650 Tablet

  • For adults and children aged 12 years and above, the usual dosage is one tablet (650 mg) every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain or fever relief.
  • It is important not to exceed four tablets (2600 mg) within a 24-hour period.

How to Take Dolo 650 Tablet Safely

  • Take the tablet with a full glass of water, preferably after meals to minimize stomach discomfort.
  • Swallow the tablet whole without crushing or chewing.
  • Follow medical advice or label instructions strictly to ensure safe use.

Maximum Daily Dosage Limits

  • Do not take more than four tablets (2600 mg total) in 24 hours.
  • Maintaining a minimum gap of at least 4 hours between doses helps control overdose and reduces the risk of liver damage.

Administration Tips and Guidelines

  • Always adhere to the prescribed dosage schedule and duration.
  • Avoid self-medicating beyond the recommended time frame, usually 3 to 5 days, without consulting a healthcare provider.
  • Keep track of other medications containing paracetamol to avoid accidental overdose.

Duration of Use and When to Consult a Doctor

  • Limit use to 3 days for fever and 5 days for pain unless otherwise directed by a doctor.
  • If symptoms persist or worsen, seek medical advice promptly to rule out underlying conditions.

Dosage Adjustments for Specific Groups

  • Dosage may need modification for elderly patients, those with liver or kidney issues, or underweight individuals based on medical guidance.
  • Pediatric dosing under 12 years typically involves lower-strength formulations and weight-based calculations.

What if I forgot to take DOLO 650MG TABLET

  • If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is near the time for your next dose.
  • Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
  • Maintain the regular time interval for subsequent doses. 

Overdose

Taking an excessive amount of paracetamol may lead to serious liver damage, which can be potentially life-threatening. If an overdose is suspected, it is important to seek medical help right away, even if there are no immediate symptoms. Signs of overdose may include nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, confusion, or yellowing of the skin and eyes.

Side Effects Of DOLO 650MG TABLET

Common side effects of Dolo 650 Tablet:

  • Nausea, vomiting
  • Mild stomach discomfort
  • Dizziness
  • Headache
  • Mild skin rash

When to consult your doctor?

  • Severe allergic reactions symptoms such as difficulty breathing, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat (angioedema), or hives.
  • Signs of liver damage such as yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice), dark coloured urine, persistent stomach pain, extreme fatigue, or pale stools.
  • Low platelet counts symptoms such as unusual bleeding or bruising
  • Severe skin reactions such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, or acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis.
  • Symptoms of overdose such as persistent nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, confusion, or drowsiness.
  • Trouble speaking, breathing, shortness of breath, wheezing, or spasm of the larynx.
  • Increased heart rate and low blood pressure.

How To Manage Side Effects

Dizziness Or Drowsiness

  • Sit or Lie Down: If you feel dizzy, sit down, or lie down immediately to reduce falling. Keep your head still and close your eyes if needed.
  • Hydrate: Dehydration can cause dizziness, so drink water or electrolyte-replenishing drinks like sports drinks.
  • Avoid Sudden Movements: When standing or sitting, do so slowly to avoid triggering dizziness. Take your time when getting up.
  • Eat Small, Regular Meals: Low blood sugar can cause dizziness, so eat small meals throughout the day and avoid skipping meals.
  • Fresh Air: Sometimes dizziness can be alleviated by taking slow, deep breaths in a well-ventilated area.

Headache

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to help ease headache symptoms.
  • Rest in a Quiet Environment: Minimize noise and bright lights by resting in a calm, dark room.
  • Use Over-the-Counter Pain Relief: Consult your doctor about using mild pain relievers like acetaminophen to alleviate headaches.
  • Avoid Stressful Activities: Limit activities that increase stress or physical exertion when experiencing headaches.
  • Seek Medical Advice: Contact your healthcare provider if headaches become severe, persistent, or are accompanied by other symptoms.

Nausea And Vomiting

  • Stay Hydrated: Sip fluids slowly, such as water, ginger tea, or clear soups to support hydration and reduce discomfort.
  • Eat Small, Bland Meals: Choose light foods like crackers, toast, or plain rice to minimize stomach irritation.
  • Avoid Strong Odors and Spicy Foods: These can worsen feelings of nausea and should be limited during symptoms.
  • Rest and Relaxation: Rest in a comfortable position and avoid sudden movements to calm the digestive system.
  • Seek Medical Advice: Consult a healthcare provider promptly if nausea is severe, persistent, or accompanied by vomiting.

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

Use with Caution

Dolo 650 Tablet should be used with caution in pregnant women and only if clearly necessary, as determined by a healthcare professional. Your doctor will prescribe the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration to manage pain or fever. Do not self-medicate during pregnancy always consult your doctor for personalized advice before using this medicine.  

Breastfeeding

Consult your doctor

This medicine is generally considered safe while breastfeeding if taken as recommended but always use Dolo 650 with caution. Discuss with your doctor prior to starting management during lactation.

Driving and Using Machines

Use with Caution

Dolo 650 Tablet does not impair your ability to drive or operate machinery. It is safe to perform routine activities after taking this medication.

Alcohol

Use with Caution

Use Dolo 650 with caution if you consume alcohol. Chronic alcohol use or liver problems due to alcoholism can increase the risk of serious liver damage. Avoid excessive alcohol intake while on this medicine and consult your doctor if you have alcohol dependence.

Kidney

Use with Caution

Dolo 650 Tablet should be used with caution in individuals with severe kidney disease. Inform your doctor if you have any kidney issues dose adjustments or special monitoring may be needed for safe use. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

Use with Caution

This tablet can cause or worsen liver damage if used at high doses or in people with underlying liver disease or chronic alcoholism. Do not exceed the recommended dose and always consult your doctor if you have liver issues before starting Dolo 650 Tablet.

Allergy

Contraindicated

Do not take Dolo 650 Tablet if you are allergic to paracetamol (acetaminophen) or any of the excipients in this product. If you develop allergic symptoms such as rash, itching, swelling, or breathlessness, discontinue immediately and seek medical attention.

Use In Pediatrics

Consult your doctor

Dolo 650 Tablet is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use In Geriatrics

Use with Caution

Dolo 650 Tablet should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Other Warnings for DOLO 650MG TABLET

Before taking Dolo 650 Tablet, inform your doctor if you:

  • have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
  • are malnourished

Safety Advice

  • Dosage Limit: Do not take more than the recommended number of tablets in 24 hours. Overuse can cause serious liver damage.
  • Other Medicines: Avoid taking Dolo 650 Tablet along with other products containing paracetamol to prevent accidental overdose.
  • Medical Conditions: Inform your doctor if you have anemia, dehydration, malnutrition, or chronic alcohol use before taking this medicine.
  • Duration of Use: Do not use Dolo 650 Tablet for an extended period without medical guidance. If discomfort continues, seek professional advice.
  • Missed Dose: If you forget a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s almost time for the next dose, skip the missed one do not double the dose.

Drug - Drug interaction

Before taking Dolo 650 Tablet, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

  1. Blood Thinners (e.g., Warfarin, Aspirin)
    Interaction:     Combining Dolo 650 with blood thinners can increase the risk of bleeding.
    Effects: Symptoms may include unusual bruising, bleeding gums, blood in stools or urine.
    Management: Inform your doctor if you experience any signs of bleeding. Your doctor may adjust doses or monitor you more closely to ensure safety.
     
  2. Cholestyramine
    Interaction:     Cholestyramine can reduce the absorption of Dolo 650, decreasing its effectiveness.
    Effects: Reduced pain relief and fever control.
    Management: Take Dolo 650 and cholestyramine doses several hours apart to minimize interaction.
     
  3. Other Pain Medications Containing Paracetamol
    Interaction:     Taking Dolo 650 with other paracetamol-containing medicines increases the risk of overdose and liver damage.
    Effects: Symptoms may include nausea, vomiting, jaundice, abdominal pain, and liver failure.
    Management: Always check active ingredients and do not exceed the recommended total daily dose of paracetamol. Consult your doctor before combining such medicines.
     
  4. Antiepileptic Drugs (e.g., Carbamazepine, Phenytoin)
    Interaction:     These drugs can increase the metabolism of paracetamol, potentially reducing its effectiveness.
    Effects: Reduced pain and fever relief.
    Management: Inform your doctor for appropriate dose adjustments and monitoring.
     
  5. Antidepressants (Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors - SSRIs)
    Interaction:     Co-administration may increase bleeding risk when combined with blood thinners.
    Effects: Increased risk of bruising and bleeding.
    Management: Consult your healthcare provider for monitoring and dose adjustments.

Drug - Food interaction

  1. Alcohol
    Interaction:     Consuming alcohol while taking Dolo 650 increases the risk of serious liver damage. Both alcohol and paracetamol are processed by the liver, and combined use puts extra strain on this vital organ.
    Effects: Symptoms may include jaundice (yellowing of skin or eyes), fatigue, dark urine, and abdominal pain due to liver toxicity.
    Management: Avoid alcohol consumption during management with Dolo 650 to protect your liver and reduce the risk of harmful side effects. Inform your doctor if you consume alcohol regularly.
     
  2. Caffeinated Foods and Beverages (e.g., Tea, Coffee, Cola, Chocolate)
    Interaction:     These foods and beverages may reduce the effectiveness of Dolo 650 or increase the risk of side effects such as stomach upset or insomnia in sensitive individuals.
    Effects: May experience reduced pain relief or mild gastrointestinal discomfort.
    Management: Limit intake of caffeinated products while on Dolo 650 and consult your healthcare provider if you notice unusual symptoms.
     
  3. Fatty or Greasy Foods
    Interaction:     High-fat meals can delay the absorption of paracetamol from the gastrointestinal tract, slowing the onset of its pain-relieving effects.
    Effects: Slower relief of pain and fever symptoms.
    Management: Consume a balanced diet and avoid excessive fatty or oily foods when taking this medication for better efficacy.
     
  4. Taking Dolo 650 with or without Food
    Interaction:     Dolo 650 can be taken with or without food, but taking it with a meal or snack is recommended to minimize stomach irritation or upset.
    Effects: Reduced risk of nausea or indigestion for sensitive individuals.
    Management: To avoid stomach discomfort, take the tablet after meals or with a glass of milk or water.

More Information

01. Why Do Doctors Recommend Dolo 650 Instead of Other Pain Relief Tablets?

Doctors often recommend Dolo 650 as a first-line option for managing pain and fever due to its effectiveness, safety, and overall tolerability. Here are the main reasons:

Effective pain and fever relief:
Dolo 650 contains paracetamol, which works by blocking chemical messengers in the brain responsible for pain and fever. It helps relieve mild to moderate pain such as headaches, muscle aches, menstrual cramps, toothache, and reduces high body temperature effectively.

Gentle on the stomach:
Compared to many NSAID pain relievers, Dolo 650 is generally gentler on the stomach and less likely to cause irritation, ulcers, or bleeding when taken as directed. This makes it suitable for people with sensitive digestion.

Wide safety margin:
Paracetamol has a well-known safety profile when used within recommended doses. It does not cause dependency or addiction and is considered reliable for repeated use under medical supervision.

Suitable for multiple conditions:
Dolo 650 can be used for various conditions including cold and flu symptoms, post-vaccination discomfort, arthritis-related pain, and general body aches. Its dual action on pain and fever makes it a versatile option.

Fast onset of action:
It typically starts working within 30–60 minutes and provides relief for about 4–6 hours, helping improve comfort quickly.

Availability and affordability:
Dolo 650 is widely available and affordable, making it accessible to most patients, especially during high-demand periods such as flu season.

Non-NSAID classification:
As it is not an NSAID, Dolo 650 avoids common NSAID-related risks like stomach bleeding, cardiovascular issues, and severe gastric irritation in most users.

Overall, doctors prefer Dolo 650 for its effective relief, good safety profile, stomach friendliness, and accessibility.

02. Best Lifestyle and Diet Tips While Taking Dolo 650 Tablet

Following simple lifestyle and diet measures can help improve the safety and effectiveness of Dolo 650:

Take with food or milk:
Taking the tablet with food or milk may help reduce mild stomach discomfort in sensitive individuals.

Avoid alcohol consumption:
Avoid alcohol while taking Dolo 650, as combining alcohol with paracetamol can increase the risk of liver damage.

Follow prescribed dosage:
Do not exceed the recommended dose. Usually, no more than 4 tablets (650 mg each) in 24 hours unless advised by a doctor. Maintain at least a 4-hour gap between doses.

Limit fatty and greasy foods:
Heavy or fatty meals may delay absorption of the medicine. Light meals are preferable during treatment.

Stay hydrated:
Drink plenty of water and take the tablet with a full glass of water for better absorption and comfort.

Avoid taking antacids close to dosing:
Avoid taking antacids within about 2 hours of Dolo 650 unless advised, as they may affect absorption.

Consult doctor for long-term use:
If you need Dolo 650 for extended periods, regular monitoring of liver and kidney function may be required.

Maintain a balanced diet:
Eat a balanced diet and avoid foods that trigger acidity or gastric discomfort if you are sensitive.

Do not double dose:
If you miss a dose, take it when remembered, but never take two doses together to make up for a missed one.

Adequate rest and moderate activity:
Rest well during fever or pain episodes and avoid strenuous activity until you recover.

03. Dolo 650 vs Other Pain Relievers – Which Works Best for Fever and Body Pain?

Dolo 650 (Paracetamol):
Dolo 650 contains paracetamol and is commonly used for fever and mild to moderate pain such as headaches, body aches, and menstrual discomfort. It has minimal anti-inflammatory action but is preferred for fever due to its good safety profile and low risk of stomach irritation when used correctly.

NSAID pain relievers (Ibuprofen, Combiflam):
NSAIDs like ibuprofen provide both pain relief and strong anti-inflammatory action. They are often chosen when pain is linked to inflammation, such as joint swelling, muscle injury, or arthritis. However, they may cause stomach irritation, acidity, or bleeding in some individuals and should be used cautiously.

Aspirin:
Aspirin helps reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, but it is less commonly used for routine fever management due to its higher risk of stomach irritation and bleeding. It is usually avoided in children and certain medical conditions.

Combination pain relievers (Paracetamol + NSAID, e.g., Hifenac-P):
These combinations provide broader relief by addressing both fever and inflammation. They are helpful when symptoms involve both pain and swelling but carry a higher risk of side effects such as gastric irritation and should be used only under medical guidance.

Which works best?

  • For simple fever and mild body pain: Dolo 650 is usually preferred due to safety and stomach tolerance.
  • For pain involving inflammation: NSAIDs or combination medicines may be more effective but require caution.
  • Aspirin is effective but less preferred for routine fever care.

Overall, Dolo 650 remains a commonly recommended and trusted option for managing fever and general body pain safely when used as directed.

FAQs About DOLO 650MG TABLET

Q: What is Dolo 650 Tablet used for?

FAQs About NEUROBION FORTE TABLET

Q: What is the use of Neurobion Forte tablet?

A: Neurobion Forte is a vitamin supplement used to support nerve health and manage vitamin B deficiencies. It contains a combination of B vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B6, and B12) that are crucial for maintaining healthy nerve function, reducing nerve pain, and promoting overall nervous system health. It's commonly recommended for conditions like neuropathy, sciatica, and diabetic nerve damage, as well as for improving energy levels and managing stress.

Q: Can I take Neurobion Forte daily?

A: Yes, Neurobion Forte can be taken daily as per your doctor's recommendation. Typically, 1 tablet per day is suggested to help address vitamin deficiencies, improve nerve function, and support overall health. However, always follow the instructions provided by your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use.

Q: Is Neurobion Forte good for nerves?

A: Yes, Neurobion Forte is specifically formulated to support nerve health. The B vitamins it contains, especially Vitamin B1 (Thiamine), B6 (Pyridoxine), and B12 (Cyanocobalamin), are essential for proper nerve function, reducing the risk of nerve damage, and alleviating symptoms such as tingling, numbness, or pain. It is often used to manage conditions like peripheral neuropathy and diabetic neuropathy.

Q: What is the best time to take Neurobion Forte?

A: The best time to take Neurobion Forte is typically with a meal. Taking it with food helps to enhance the absorption of the vitamins and minimize any potential stomach irritation. Some people prefer to take it in the morning to start their day with the benefits of energy-boosting B vitamins, but it can be taken at any time that fits your schedule.

Q: What are the benefits of taking Neurobion Forte tablet?

A: Neurobion Forte helps promote nerve health by supporting the repair and regeneration of nerve cells. It helps prevent vitamin B deficiencies, which may occur due to conditions such as diabetes, alcoholism, or inadequate dietary intake. The supplement also supports energy production by aiding the metabolism of carbohydrates and fats. Additionally, it may help reduce nerve pain, tingling, and discomfort associated with neuropathy. Neurobion Forte supports brain function, mental clarity, concentration, and mood, and may also assist in recovery following surgery or nerve-related injuries

Q: Does Neurobion Forte repair nerve damage?

A: While Neurobion Forte helps support nerve health and can aid in nerve repair, it does not reverse nerve damage that has already occurred. However, regular intake of the vitamins in Neurobion Forte can prevent further damage, reduce inflammation, and promote the regeneration of nerve cells, especially in conditions like diabetic neuropathy or nerve compression.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte have side effects?

A: Neurobion Forte is generally well-tolerated when used as directed. However, in rare cases, some individuals may experience mild stomach discomfort or nausea if taken without food. Allergic reactions, such as rash or itching, may occur in sensitive individuals. Excessive intake of B vitamins could lead to symptoms like headaches or nervousness. If any severe reactions occur, discontinue use and consult your healthcare provider.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte help sleep?

A: While Neurobion Forte is not specifically a sleep aid, the vitamins, particularly B6, play a role in the production of serotonin and melatonin, which are hormones that regulate mood and sleep cycles. Taking Neurobion Forte may help improve sleep quality for some individuals, especially if they are experiencing sleep disturbances due to nerve pain or vitamin deficiencies.

Q: What vitamins are in Neurobion Forte?

A: Neurobion Forte contains a combination of B vitamins that support various functions in the body. Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) supports nerve function and energy production. Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) enhances cellular metabolism and nerve health. Vitamin B3 (Niacinamide) helps maintain proper nerve function and reduces inflammation. Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine) is essential for neurotransmitter function and reducing nerve pain. Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) is important for red blood cell formation, nerve health, and brain function.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte have vitamin B7?

A: No, Neurobion Forte does not contain Vitamin B7 (also known as biotin). While biotin plays a role in maintaining healthy skin, hair, and nails, it is not part of the vitamin complex in Neurobion Forte. If you are looking for a supplement to address biotin deficiency, you may need a separate biotin supplement.

Q: Is Neurobion Forte good for B12 deficiency?

A: Yes, Neurobion Forte is excellent for Vitamin B12 deficiency. It contains Cyanocobalamin (a form of Vitamin B12), which is essential for nerve health, red blood cell production, and DNA synthesis. If you have a B12 deficiency due to diet, age, or health conditions like pernicious anemia or diabetes, Neurobion Forte can help replenish your B12 levels.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte increase sugar levels?

A: Neurobion Forte does not directly affect blood sugar levels. However, it is important to monitor your blood sugar if you have diabetes or other conditions that impact glucose metabolism. The B vitamins in Neurobion Forte may help manage diabetic neuropathy and improve nerve function in diabetic patients, but they should not be used as a substitute for managing blood sugar levels.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte cause acidity?

A: In some individuals, taking Neurobion Forte on an empty stomach may cause mild stomach discomfort or acidity. To minimize this, it is recommended to take the tablet with food. If acidity persists, consider speaking with your healthcare provider to adjust your dosage or try an alternative supplement.

Q: Does Neurobion Forte affect urine color?

A: Yes, taking Neurobion Forte may cause your urine to turn a bright yellow or orange. This is due to the B vitamins, particularly B2 (riboflavin), being excreted in the urine and is harmless.

Q: How does Neurobion Forte help with nerve pain?

A: Neurobion Forte contains B vitamins, which are essential for nerve function and health. It helps in reducing nerve inflammation, promoting nerve regeneration, and alleviating nerve pain by supporting the nervous system.

Introduction About COMBIFLAM TABLET

Combiflam Tablet is commonly chosen for short-term relief from everyday pain and fever. It is often used by people experiencing discomfort due to headache, body ache, toothache, muscle soreness, joint pain, or fever linked to routine conditions. Its dual-action formula combines ibuprofen and paracetamol, offering supportive relief when quick comfort is needed during busy routines or sudden aches.  

The tablet works by helping ease pain signals and lowering raised body temperature. It is ideally used by adults and older children who need convenient and fast relief from mild to moderate discomfort. It suits individuals looking for short-duration support without requiring stronger medicines. However, it should be taken only when needed and not for long-term or chronic pain unless advised by a healthcare professional.   

Combiflam is best taken after food or with a light snack to reduce the chances of acidity or stomach discomfort. Follow the recommended dose and maintain the advised gap between doses. Avoid combining it with other pain relievers or products that contain ibuprofen or paracetamol, as this may unintentionally increase the total dose. People with stomach ulcers, kidney or liver concerns, asthma, or heart-related issues should use it only after medical guidance. Inform your doctor if you are taking blood thinners, diuretics, or multiple medications. 

During pregnancy, especially in later stages, the tablet may not be suitable due to the ibuprofen component and should be used only after medical advice. Breastfeeding mothers should also consult a healthcare provider before taking it. Common side effects may include mild stomach discomfort, nausea, dizziness, headache, or skin reactions in sensitive individuals. If symptoms persist, worsen, or if you notice unusual reactions, seek prompt medical attention. 

Uses Of COMBIFLAM TABLET

  • It is used to manage minor aches and pains such as headaches, toothaches, muscular aches, backaches and pain due to inflammation and for reduction of fever due to any of the above conditions

Benefits of COMBIFLAM TABLET

Combiflam Tablet for Pain

Combiflam Tablet helps provide relief from different types of day-to-day pain because it contains ibuprofen and paracetamol, which work together to ease discomfort. It is commonly used for headaches, muscle pain, joint pain, back pain, toothache, and period-related cramps. The combination helps reduce swelling and soothe pain more effectively than many single-ingredient medicines. It is suitable for short-term use when quick and reliable comfort is needed. Always follow the recommended dose and speak with a healthcare professional if the pain does not settle.

Combiflam Tablet for Fever

Combiflam Tablet helps lower fever and ease the tiredness, chills, and body aches that often accompany it. Paracetamol helps reduce body temperature, while ibuprofen supports relief from associated discomfort. It is commonly used during common colds, mild infections, or general feverishness for short-term relief. Taking it with a light meal or snack helps reduce stomach irritation. If fever lasts more than a couple of days or worsens, consult a healthcare provider for further guidance.

How COMBIFLAM TABLET Works

Combiflam Tablet works through a dual-action formula containing Ibuprofen and Paracetamol, which complement each other to provide effective relief from pain and fever.

Ibuprofen is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent (NSAID). It works by blocking the formation of prostaglandins, the natural chemicals in the body that cause pain, swelling, and inflammation. By reducing these chemicals, ibuprofen helps ease body aches, joint discomfort and headache.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, acts mainly in the brain. It helps reduce fever by acting on the body’s temperature-regulating centre and provides analgesic comfort by lowering the signals that carry pain sensations.

How to use COMBIFLAM TABLET

How to Take Combiflam Tablet

  • Take the tablet after food or with a light snack to avoid stomach discomfort caused by ibuprofen.
  • Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
  • Use the tablet only when needed for pain or fever and avoid frequent or long-term use without advice.
  • Follow the dose and interval recommended by your doctor or as written on the product label.
  • Maintain a minimum gap of 6–8 hours between doses to avoid excess intake of ibuprofen or paracetamol.
  • Avoid taking it along with other medicines containing paracetamol, ibuprofen, aspirin, or similar pain relievers.
  • Do not exceed the maximum daily limit of paracetamol from all sources (including cold or flu medicines).
  • If your pain or fever continues after recommended doses, seek medical guidance rather than increasing the dose.

What if I forgot to take COMBIFLAM TABLET

  • If you miss a dose, take it when you remember only if you still need it for pain or fever.
  • If your next dose is due soon, skip the missed dose and continue your usual schedule.
  • Do not take two tablets together to make up for the missed dose.
  • Avoid taking doses too close to each other to prevent stomach discomfort or side effects.
  • Follow the recommended time gap between doses.
  • If your symptoms continue or get worse, speak with a healthcare professional.

Overdose

If you or someone else has taken more Combiflam Tablet than recommended, contact a doctor or visit a medical facility right away.   • Management: Your doctor may adjust the dose or switch to a safer alternative. Avoid taking multiple doses without supervision. Watch for signs of unusual bleeding and report immediately.   

2. Other NSAIDs (e.g., Diclofenac, Naproxen, Aspirin)

  • Interaction: Combining multiple NSAIDs increases the risk of stomach irritation, acidity, and kidney strain.
  • Management: Avoid taking Combiflam with other NSAIDs unless your doctor approves. Stick to the recommended single pain reliever. Take the medicine after food to reduce irritation.

3. Other Paracetamol-Containing Medicines

  • Interaction: Using more than one paracetamol product increases the risk of liver damage.
  • Management: Read labels carefully and avoid duplicate paracetamol doses. Use Combiflam as the only paracetamol-containing medicine. Seek advice if you are unsure about ingredients.

4. Blood Pressure Medicines (e.g., ACE inhibitors, ARBs, Diuretics)

  • Interaction: Ibuprofen may reduce the effect of BP medicines and increase kidney strain.
  • Management: Monitor your blood pressure more closely. Drink enough water and avoid long-term use. Doctors may adjust the BP medicine or suggest a safer pain-relief option. 

5. Lithium (used for mood conditions)

  • Interaction: Ibuprofen may increase lithium levels in the blood, raising toxicity risk.
  • Management: Only use Combiflam if your doctor approves. Regular blood monitoring may be suggested. Report symptoms like tremors, confusion, or dizziness.

6. Methotrexate

  • Interaction: Ibuprofen can increase the effects and side effects of methotrexate.
  • Management: Avoid combining unless strictly advised. Doctors may adjust methotrexate timing or dose. Watch for signs of toxicity such as mouth sores or tiredness.

7. Certain Antibiotics (e.g., Ciprofloxacin, Levofloxacin)

  • Interaction: Combining NSAIDs with some antibiotics may increase nervous system-related side effects in rare cases.
  • Management: Use together only if prescribed. Inform your doctor if you feel restless, anxious, or dizzy. Avoid self-medication during antibiotic use.

8. Antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs)

  • Interaction: Using SSRIs/SNRIs with ibuprofen may increase stomach bleeding risk.
  • Management: Doctor may add a stomach-protective medicine. Take after meals and avoid alcohol. Report stomach pain, black stools, or vomiting.

9. Anti-Seizure Medicines (e.g., Phenytoin, Carbamazepine)

  • Interaction: Paracetamol may interact with metabolism of some anti-seizure medicines.
  • Management: Your doctor may adjust doses or monitor levels. Avoid repeated Combiflam use without permission. Report unusual tiredness or difficulty balancing.  

10. Cholesterol-Lowering Medicines (e.g., Statins)

  • Interaction: Paracetamol is generally safe, but frequent use may increase liver strain when combined with statins.
  • Management: Limit long-term use of Combiflam. Inform the doctor if you feel muscle weakness or fatigue. Have liver tests if recommended.

11. Corticosteroids (e.g., Prednisolone)

  • Interaction: NSAIDs combined with steroids may raise the chance of stomach ulcers.
  • Management: Doctors may prescribe a gastric-protective medicine. Avoid alcohol and spicy foods. Take the tablet strictly after meals.

12. Anti-TB Medicines (e.g., Isoniazid, Rifampicin)

  • Interaction: These medicines may increase liver strain when mixed with paracetamol.
  • Management: Use Combiflam only with doctor approval. Limit frequent use. Watch for signs like yellow skin, dark urine, or loss of appetite.

Drug - Food interaction

1. Spicy or Oily Foods

  • Interaction: Spicy, oily, or deep-fried foods may irritate the stomach lining and increase the chance of acidity or stomach discomfort, especially when taking ibuprofen-containing medicines.
  • Management: Take the tablet with a light meal or a snack instead of spicy or oily food. Choose bland foods like rice, roti, or toast to keep your stomach comfortable.

2. Caffeine-Rich Foods (Coffee, Tea, Energy Drinks)

  • Interaction: Caffeine can increase the chances of stomach upset or acidity when combined with ibuprofen. 
  • Management: Try to limit coffee or energy drinks close to your dose. Opt for water or herbal tea around the time you take the tablet.

3. Grapefruit or Grapefruit Juice

  • Interaction: Grapefruit may slow down how some medicines break down in the body. Though not a major interaction, it may slightly increase stomach irritation for sensitive users.
  • Management: If you already have gastric sensitivity, avoid grapefruit close to your dose. Otherwise, occasional intake is usually acceptable.

4. Heavy Meals

  • Interaction: Taking the tablet after a very heavy or large meal may delay its absorption and reduce how quickly you feel relief.
  • Management: Take it after a normal, light meal or small snack to help the medicine work effectively without irritating the stomach.

5. Low-Carb or Fasting States

  • Interaction: Taking the tablet on an empty stomach or during fasting can increase the risk of acidity, nausea, or stomach discomfort due to ibuprofen.
  • Management: Always take the tablet with at least a small snack like biscuits, banana, or milk, even if you are fasting.

Drug: Paracetamol and Ibuprofen

Pharmacological Category: Analgesic, Antipyretic, and Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug (NSAID)

Therapeutic Indication: Fever, headache, body aches, muscle pain, joint discomfort and toothache

Dosage Forms: Tablet

More Information

a) Combiflam Tablet vs Ibuprofen Tablet

Composition:
Combiflam contains a combination of ibuprofen and paracetamol, offering dual-action relief.
Ibuprofen tablet contains only ibuprofen as a single active ingredient.

How It Works:
Combiflam provides combined action—ibuprofen reduces inflammation while paracetamol helps reduce pain and fever-like symptoms.
Ibuprofen mainly works by reducing inflammation and relieving pain through its anti-inflammatory action.

Best Suited For:
Combiflam is useful when both pain and mild fever-like symptoms occur together, such as body aches with fever.
Ibuprofen is best when inflammation is the main cause of discomfort, such as swelling or injury-related pain.

Onset and Relief:
Combiflam’s dual-action formula may provide broader relief for mixed types of pain.
Ibuprofen works well for pain associated with swelling, inflammation, or injury.

Stomach Tolerance:
Due to the presence of paracetamol, Combiflam may be gentler for some individuals compared to ibuprofen alone.
Ibuprofen alone may cause more stomach irritation in sensitive individuals.

Use in Fever-Like Symptoms:
Combiflam is often preferred when fever-like symptoms accompany pain because of the paracetamol component.
Ibuprofen alone is less commonly used for fever unless prescribed.

Flexibility of Dosing:
Combiflam dosing is limited by the safe combination levels of both ingredients.
Ibuprofen offers more flexible dosing options since it contains a single ingredient.

Suitability for Repeated Use:
Combiflam is generally not preferred for frequent or long-term use without medical supervision.
Repeated ibuprofen use may increase risks related to the stomach, kidneys, or heart.

When It May Be Chosen:
Combiflam may be chosen when broader relief is needed for headaches, body aches, or flu-like discomfort.
Ibuprofen may be preferred when inflammation is the main concern, such as joint swelling or muscle injury.

Important Caution:
While taking Combiflam, avoid using other paracetamol-containing medicines to prevent overdose.
When using ibuprofen, avoid combining with other NSAIDs to reduce the risk of stomach irritation and side effects.

b)Combiflam vs Meftal Spas

Composition:
Combiflam contains ibuprofen and paracetamol.
Meftal Spas contains dicyclomine and mefenamic acid.

Primary Action:
Combiflam works mainly by reducing pain and inflammation.
Meftal Spas works by relaxing muscle spasms and relieving pain, especially in abdominal cramps.

Best For:
Combiflam is suitable for general body aches, headaches, muscle pain, or mild discomfort.
Meftal Spas is commonly preferred for menstrual cramps, stomach cramps, and spasm-related abdominal pain.

Effect on Cramps:
Combiflam may reduce discomfort but does not directly relax muscle spasms.
Meftal Spas is specifically designed to relax spasms, making it more effective for cramp-related pain.

Stomach Tolerance:
Combiflam may cause acidity in some individuals and is best taken after food.
Meftal Spas may also cause acidity and should be used cautiously in those with sensitive stomachs.

When to Choose:
Choose Combiflam when you need broader relief from body aches or mixed pain.
Choose Meftal Spas when cramps—especially menstrual or abdominal—are the main cause of discomfort.

Important Caution:
Avoid combining Combiflam with other medicines containing paracetamol.
Meftal Spas should not be used by individuals sensitive to antispasmodics or NSAIDs unless advised by a doctor.

FAQs About COMBIFLAM TABLET

Q: What is Combiflam Tablet used for?

A: Combiflam Tablet is commonly taken to ease discomfort, body aches, and inflammation. People use it for headaches, muscle pain, joint pain, or fever-like symptoms. It combines two ingredients that support relief. It is meant for short-term use only. Follow the dose your doctor recommends.

Q: Can I take Combiflam on an empty stomach?

A: It is better to take it after food. Empty stomach use may cause acidity or irritation. Eating something light can protect your stomach. People with gastric issues should be extra careful. Follow your doctor’s advice.

Q: What are the common side effects?

A: You may experience stomach discomfort, acidity, or nausea. Some people may feel dizziness or mild allergy-like symptoms. Most side effects are short-lived. Taking it with food reduces stomach issues. Stop use and seek help if symptoms become severe.

Q: Can Combiflam cause allergies?

A: Yes, some people may get rashes, itching, or swelling. Stop the medicine if you notice unusual symptoms. Severe allergy signs need quick medical help. People allergic to NSAIDs should avoid it. Inform your doctor about past drug allergies.

Q: What happens if I take too many tablets?

A: Overdose can harm your liver or stomach. You may feel nausea, stomach pain, or dizziness. Do not wait seek medical help immediately. Keep the medicine away from children. Never exceed the recommended dose.

Q: Can Combiflam make me sleepy?

A: It usually does not cause much drowsiness. However, some people may feel dizzy or tired. Avoid driving if you feel unsteady. Take it with food to reduce discomfort. Inform your doctor if sleepiness continues.

Q: Can I use Combiflam for headaches?

A: Many people take it for headaches or body aches. Its two ingredients help reduce discomfort. Use it after meals for better tolerance. If headaches are frequent, seek medical help. Do not use it daily without advice.

Q: Can I take Combiflam with antibiotics?

A: In many cases, both can be taken together. But some combinations may increase stomach irritation. Always inform your doctor about all medicines. Your doctor will guide you on safe use. Report any unusual symptoms.

Q: Does Combiflam affect the stomach?

A: Yes, it may cause acidity or irritation in some people. Take it with food to reduce discomfort. Avoid spicy foods and alcohol during use. People with ulcers should be cautious. Stop use if stomach pain becomes severe.

Q: Who should avoid Combiflam?

A: People with severe liver, kidney, or stomach issues should avoid it. Those allergic to NSAIDs should not use it. Pregnant women should avoid it unless advised. Regular alcohol drinkers should be cautious. Always check warnings on the label.

Q: Can Combiflam increase blood pressure?

A: Ibuprofen may cause a small rise in BP in some people. Those with high BP should use it cautiously. Avoid long-term or frequent use. Monitor symptoms if you feel uneasy. Speak to your doctor if you have BP issues.

Q: Is Combiflam safe for diabetic patients?

A: Diabetic patients should take it only if a doctor approves. Ibuprofen may sometimes affect kidney function. Monitor your blood sugar if you feel unwell. Do not take it regularly without guidance. Share your medical history with your doctor.

Q: Can Combiflam cause acidity?

A: Yes, acidity is a common side effect. Taking it with meals helps reduce irritation. Avoid spicy and oily foods while using it. Drink enough water for better digestion. Seek medical help if acidity becomes severe.

Q: Can I take Combiflam if I have asthma?

A: People with asthma should be cautious. Some may experience breathing issues with NSAIDs. Inform your doctor before using it. Use it only if your doctor says it is safe. Stop use if breathing becomes difficult.

Q: What should I do if my pain doesn’t improve?

A: If pain continues after taking the tablet, avoid taking extra doses. Persistent symptoms may need medical evaluation. Your doctor can check for underlying causes. Do not rely on Combiflam for long-term relief. Use only as advised and seek help if symptoms last.

Introduction About CROCIN 650MG TABLET

CROCIN 650MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. CROCIN 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with CROCIN 650MG TABLET.

Uses Of CROCIN 650MG TABLET

  • relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
  • lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu

How CROCIN 650MG TABLET Works

CROCIN 650MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat. 

How to use CROCIN 650MG TABLET

Take CROCIN 650MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow CROCIN 650MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition. 

Side Effects Of CROCIN 650MG TABLET

Rare

  • reduced white blood cells (infections are more likely to occur)

Stop taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

  • allergic reaction (swelling of the hands, feet, ankles, face, lips or throat which may cause trouble swallowing or breathing, an itchy, lumpy rash or nettle rash, runny nose)

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

CROCIN 650MG TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.

Alcohol

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Kidney

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy

Do not take CROCIN 650MG TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

  • have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
  • are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

CROCIN 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

CROCIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:             

  • other medicines containing paracetamol
  • medicines to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone)
  • cholestyramine (used to control blood lipid levels)
  • warfarin (used for managing blood clots)
  • medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. rifampicin, flucloxacillin, chloramphenicol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CROCIN 650MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital, even if you feel well, as it can cause delayed, serious liver damage.

Pharmacological Category :   Para aminophenol derivative
Therapeutic Indication :   Pain, Fever

  • Store below 25°C

FAQs About CROCIN 650MG TABLET

Q: What is the use of CROCIN 650MG TABLET?

A: CROCIN 650MG TABLET is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever. It contains paracetamol (acetaminophen) and is often used for conditions like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, associated with various illnesses.

Q: What happens if I take CROCIN 650MG TABLET?

A: CROCIN 650MG TABLET contains a medicine called paracetamol which is an analgesic and antipyretic agent. Following administration, it works by blocking the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Paracetamol also manages the release of such chemicals in the hypothalamus of the brain which helps in controlling fever.

Q: Can I take two doses of CROCIN 650MG TABLET in a day?

A: The dosage of CROCIN 650MG TABLET is decided by your physician. However, studies have shown that taking paracetamol once in every 4-6 hours significantly reduced fever and body pains.

Q: Can we use CROCIN 650MG TABLET for cold?

A: CROCIN 650MG TABLET could be used in the management of sore throat and body pains that is associated with common cold. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain, like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, and fever associated with various illnesses.

Q. Can I take CROCIN 650MG TABLET as often as required?

A: The dosage of CROCIN 650MG TABLET and duration of the therapy would be decided by your doctor. It is usually not recommended to take more than 4 doses of CROCIN 650MG TABLET in a day. Leave a time gap of 4-6 hours, between each dose.

Q: Is CROCIN 650MG TABLET a strong medicine?

A: CROCIN 650MG TABLET is relatively an effective medicine in controlling fever and body pain. It is typically used for mild to moderate pain relief and fever reduction. However, it should be used as directed, and exceeding the recommended dosage can lead to adverse effects.

Q: When would CROCIN 650MG TABLET start working?

A: It takes around 30 minutes for you to feel better after taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET.

Q: Can I take CROCIN 650MG TABLET and ibuprofen together?

A: It is generally advisable to avoid taking CROCIN 650MG TABLET (paracetamol) and ibuprofen together unless recommended by a healthcare professional. Mixing these medications can increase the risk of side effects and potential harm to the liver and stomach.

Q: When should we discontinue the use of Paracetamol?

A: Discontinue the use of Paracetamol if you experience allergic reactions, severe skin reactions, liver problems, or if you consume alcohol regularly. Always consult a healthcare professional if you have concerns or experience adverse effects.

Q: Is CROCIN 650MG TABLET an antibiotic?

No. CROCIN 650MG TABLET is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine. It works by reducing fever and provides pain relief.

Q: What happens if I take more doses of CROCIN 650MG TABLET than recommended to me?

A: Taking more than the recommended doses of CROCIN 650MG TABLET may be harmful. Studies have shown that the overdosage of paracetamol may affect your liver and gastrointestinal tract. Symptoms of overdosage might include vomiting, loss of appetite, stomach pain, paleness and nausea.

Q: Can CROCIN 650MG TABLET be used for a headache?

A: Yes. CROCIN 650MG TABLET can relieve your headache. It can also symptomatically manage headaches, however, cannot manage the underlying cause. If you experience recurrent headaches, please consult your doctor. In such cases, avoid self-medication with over-the-counter pain killers.

Q: Can CROCIN 650MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?

A: CROCIN 650MG TABLET can be used during pregnancy, however not during the last trimester as it could delay the onset of pain sensation. If necessary, you should use the lowest possible dose that reduces your pain and/or your fever and use it for the shortest time possible.

Q: What happens if I take Dolo 650 without fever?

A: Dolo 650 tablet is generally used for managing pain and fever, It can be used without getting a fever in most cases, especially if you have headaches, toothaches, or period cramps.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Side Effects Of DOLO 500MG TABLET

Rare

  • reduced white blood cells (infections are more likely to occur)

Stop taking DOLO 500MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

  • allergic reaction (swelling of the hands, feet, ankles, face, lips or throat which may cause trouble swallowing or breathing, an itchy, lumpy rash or nettle rash, runny nose)

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking DOLO 500MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

DOLO 500MG TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.

Alcohol

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Kidney

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy

Do not take DOLO 500MG TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking DOLO 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

  • have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
  • are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

DOLO 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

DOLO 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking DOLO 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:             

  • other medicines containing paracetamol
  • medicines to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone)
  • cholestyramine (used to control blood lipid levels)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DOLO 500MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital, even if you feel well, as it can cause delayed, serious liver damage.

FAQs About DOLO 500MG TABLET

Q: What is the use of DOLO 500MG TABLET?

A: DOLO 500MG TABLET is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever. It contains paracetamol (acetaminophen) and is often used for conditions like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, associated with various illnesses.

Q: What happens if I take DOLO 500MG TABLET?

A: DOLO 500MG TABLET contains a medicine called paracetamol which is an analgesic and antipyretic agent. Following administration, it works by blocking the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Paracetamol also manages the release of such chemicals in the hypothalamus of the brain which helps in controlling fever.

Q: Can I take two doses of DOLO 500MG TABLET in a day?

A: The dosage of DOLO 500MG TABLET is decided by your physician. However, studies have shown that taking paracetamol once in every 4-6 hours significantly reduced fever and body pains.

Q: Can we use DOLO 500MG TABLET for cold?

A: DOLO 500MG TABLET could be used in the management of sore throat and body pains that is associated with common cold. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain, like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, and fever associated with various illnesses.

Q. Can I take DOLO 500MG TABLET as often as required?

A: The dosage of DOLO 500MG TABLET and duration of the therapy would be decided by your doctor. It is usually not recommended to take more than 4 doses of DOLO 500MG TABLET in a day. Leave a time gap of 4-6 hours, between each dose.

Q: Is DOLO 500MG TABLET a strong medicine?

A: DOLO 500MG TABLET is relatively an effective medicine in controlling fever and body pain. It is typically used for mild to moderate pain relief and fever reduction. However, it should be used as directed, and exceeding the recommended dosage can lead to adverse effects.

Q: When would DOLO 500MG TABLET start working?

A: It takes around 30 minutes for you to feel better after taking DOLO 500MG TABLET.

Q: Can I take DOLO 500MG TABLET and ibuprofen together?

A: It is generally advisable to avoid taking DOLO 500MG TABLET (paracetamol) and ibuprofen together unless recommended by a healthcare professional. Mixing these medications can increase the risk of side effects and potential harm to the liver and stomach.

Q: When should we discontinue the use of Paracetamol?

A: Discontinue the use of Paracetamol if you experience allergic reactions, severe skin reactions, liver problems, or if you consume alcohol regularly. Always consult a healthcare professional if you have concerns or experience adverse effects.

Q: Is DOLO 500MG TABLET an antibiotic?

No. DOLO 500MG TABLET is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine. It works by reducing fever and provides pain relief.

Q: What happens if I take more doses of DOLO 500MG TABLET than recommended to me?

A: Taking more than the recommended doses of DOLO 500MG TABLET may be harmful. Studies have shown that the overdosage of paracetamol may affect your liver and gastrointestinal tract. Symptoms of overdosage might include vomiting, loss of appetite, stomach pain, paleness and nausea.

Q: Can DOLO 500MG TABLET be used for a headache?

A: Yes. DOLO 500MG TABLET can relieve your headache. It can also symptomatically manage headaches, however, cannot manage the underlying cause. If you experience recurrent headaches, please consult your doctor. In such cases, avoid self-medication with over-the-counter pain killers.

Q: Can DOLO 500MG TABLET be used during pregnancy?

A: DOLO 500MG TABLET can be used during pregnancy, however not during the last trimester as it could delay the onset of pain sensation. If necessary, you should use the lowest possible dose that reduces your pain and/or your fever and use it for the shortest time possible.

Q: What happens if I take Dolo 650 without fever?

A: Dolo 650 tablet is generally used for managing pain and fever, It can be used without getting a fever in most cases, especially if you have headaches, toothaches, or period cramps.

Introduction About LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet contains levocetirizine, a second-generation antihistamine commonly used to help manage symptoms associated with seasonal allergies, year-round allergic conditions, and chronic skin irritation accompanied by itching. It works by blocking the action of histamine, a naturally occurring substance in the body that can trigger symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, nasal itching, and raised itchy skin rashes (hives). Levocetirizine is known for providing symptom relief with a lower tendency to cause drowsiness compared to some older antihistamines, although individual responses may vary.

This medicine is generally suitable for adults and children aged 6 years and above when recommended by a healthcare professional. It may be particularly beneficial for individuals who frequently experience allergy-related symptoms due to dust, pollen, pet dander, environmental allergens, or recurrent itching associated with chronic urticaria. Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet is usually taken once daily, preferably in the evening, with or without food. The tablet should be swallowed whole with water and taken exactly as advised by a healthcare professional. Taking more than the recommended dose is unlikely to provide additional benefit and may increase the likelihood of unwanted effects such as sleepiness.

Before using Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet, inform your healthcare provider about any kidney-related conditions, urinary difficulties, liver concerns, or other ongoing medical conditions. Some individuals may experience drowsiness, fatigue, dry mouth, headache, or dizziness while using this medicine. As a precaution, avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring full alertness until you know how the medicine affects you. Alcohol and other medicines that can cause sleepiness may enhance these effects and should be used cautiously.

If you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet. Available safety information suggests that levocetirizine is not expected to cause harm during pregnancy when used under medical supervision; however, individual risk-benefit assessment remains important. Small amounts may pass into breast milk, and healthcare guidance is recommended before use during breastfeeding. Commonly reported side effects include sleepiness, tiredness, dry mouth, headache, cough, and occasional stomach discomfort, which are generally mild and temporary. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or become bothersome.  

Uses Of LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

  • Helps manage symptoms associated with seasonal allergic rhinitis, including sneezing, runny nose, nasal itching, and watery eyes.
  • Supports relief from year-round allergies triggered by dust mites, pet dander, mold, and other environmental allergens.
  • Helps reduce itching, redness, and raised skin rashes (hives) associated with chronic urticaria.
  • Assists in controlling discomfort caused by allergy-related skin reactions.
  • Suitable for individuals experiencing recurrent allergy symptoms that may affect daily activities, sleep quality, or overall comfort.

Benefits of LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

Helps Manage Seasonal and Year-Round Allergy Symptoms

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet contains levocetirizine, an antihistamine that helps manage allergy symptoms triggered by pollen, dust mites, pet dander, and other environmental allergens. It works by blocking histamine, a substance involved in allergic reactions. This may help individuals stay comfortable during seasonal changes or ongoing exposure to allergens.

Supports Relief from Sneezing, Runny Nose, and Itchy Eyes

Frequent sneezing, a runny nose, watery eyes, and nasal itching can interfere with daily activities and overall comfort. Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet helps reduce these common allergy-related symptoms by limiting the effects of histamine in the body. Its action may support better day-to-day functioning during allergy flare-ups.

Helps Reduce Itching and Discomfort Associated with Hives

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet may help relieve itching, redness, and raised skin bumps associated with chronic urticaria (hives). By reducing the body's histamine response, it helps calm skin irritation and improve overall comfort. This can be particularly beneficial for individuals experiencing recurrent episodes of itchy skin rashes.

Convenient Once-Daily Antihistamine for Lasting Comfort

The once-daily dosing schedule of Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet makes it a convenient option for managing allergy symptoms. It can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time each day, as directed by a healthcare professional. This simple dosing routine may support consistent symptom control throughout the day and night.

How LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET Works

Helps Reduce Common Allergy Symptoms

Helps reduce symptoms associated with allergic conditions by blocking histamine, a substance released by the body during allergic reactions. This action may help ease symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and nasal irritation.

Provides Long-Lasting Antihistamine Action

Offers prolonged antihistamine activity, helping to control allergy-related symptoms throughout the day. Its once-daily dosing schedule provides convenience and supports consistent symptom management. This may help reduce the need for multiple doses during the day

Works Against Seasonal and Year-Round Allergies

Individuals experiencing allergies triggered by pollen, dust mites, pet dander, mold, and other environmental allergens. It can help manage symptoms associated with both seasonal allergies and persistent allergic conditions. This makes it suitable for use across different allergy seasons and environments.

Helps Improve Daily Comfort During Allergy Episodes

Allergy symptoms can interfere with routine activities, sleep quality, and overall well-being. By helping manage symptoms such as itching, sneezing, and watery eyes, Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet may support greater comfort during allergy episodes. This can help individuals maintain their daily activities with fewer disruptions.

How to use LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

  • Take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet exactly as prescribed by your healthcare professional.
  • Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or break it unless advised otherwise.
  • It can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time each day for consistent results.
  • The tablet is often taken in the evening, as it may cause drowsiness in some individuals.
  • Do not exceed the recommended dose, as taking more than prescribed may increase the risk of side effects.
  • If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
  • Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may increase sleepiness or dizziness.
  • Continue using the medicine for the duration recommended by your healthcare provider.   

What if I forgot to take LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

  • If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
  • If it is nearly time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing routine.
  • Do not take two doses at the same time or an extra dose to make up for the missed one.
  • Missing a dose may reduce the medicine's ability to help manage allergy symptoms effectively.
  • To help avoid missed doses, consider taking the tablet at the same time each day or setting a reminder.
  • If you frequently forget doses, consult your healthcare professional for advice on maintaining a consistent medication schedule.

Overdose

Taking more than the recommended dose of Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet may increase the likelihood of side effects. Symptoms of overdosage can include excessive drowsiness, restlessness, dizziness, or unusual tiredness. In children, overdosage may initially cause agitation or irritability, followed by sleepiness. If an overdose is suspected, seek immediate medical attention or contact a healthcare professional for appropriate guidance. Carry the medicine pack with you to help healthcare providers assess the situation.

Side Effects Of LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

Common Side Effects of Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet:

  • dry mouth
  • diarrhea, constipation
  • headache
  • tiredness
  • sleepiness/drowsiness
  • difficulty in sleeping
  • stomach (abdominal) pain

How To Manage Side Effects

Diarrhea

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of fluids such as water, coconut water, rice water, or oral rehydration solution (ORS) to prevent dehydration. Take small sips frequently, especially after each loose stool.
  • Eat Light Foods: Choose easy-to-digest foods like bananas, rice, toast, curd, boiled potatoes, and khichdi. Eat small meals instead of heavy meals to reduce stomach discomfort.
  • Avoid Trigger Foods and Drinks: Avoid oily, spicy, fried, and heavy foods until digestion improves. Stay away from milk, caffeine, alcohol, and soft drinks if they make symptoms worse.
  • Take Proper Rest: Rest well and avoid heavy physical activity until your body feels better.
  • Maintain Hygiene: Wash your hands properly before eating and after using the toilet. Avoid outside food and drink only clean, safe water.
  • Support Gut Health: Probiotic foods like curd or buttermilk may help improve digestion if tolerated

Headache

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water, as dehydration can sometimes trigger headaches. Coconut water or fresh fruit juices may also help maintain fluid balance.
  • Take Proper Rest: Rest in a quiet, dark room and avoid bright lights or loud noises. Getting enough sleep may help reduce headache discomfort.
  • Apply a Cold or Warm Compress: Place a cold compress on the forehead for relief from tension headaches. A warm compress on the neck or shoulders may help relax tight muscles.
  • Eat Light and Regular Meals: Do not skip meals, as low blood sugar can trigger headaches.  Choose light, balanced meals and healthy snacks when needed.
  • Limit Screen Time: Reduce mobile, laptop, or TV screen exposure if eye strain is causing the headache. Take short breaks and rest your eyes regularly.
  • Avoid Triggers: Stay away from strong smells, loud sounds, and stress if they worsen your headache. Limit caffeine and avoid alcohol if they trigger symptoms.
  • Gentle Relaxation: Deep breathing, light stretching, or a short walk may help reduce stress-related headaches.

Stomach Pain

  • Take the Medicine as Directed: Follow the dosage instructions provided by your healthcare professional. Taking the medicine with food, if recommended, may help reduce stomach discomfort.
  • Eat Small, Frequent Meals: Opt for light meals throughout the day instead of large or heavy meals. Foods such as rice, toast, bananas, oatmeal, and boiled vegetables may be easier on the stomach.
  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water and other clear fluids to support digestion and overall comfort. Avoid drinking large amounts of fluids at once if it worsens bloating or discomfort.
  • Avoid Trigger Foods: Limit spicy, oily, fried, highly processed, or very acidic foods, as they may aggravate stomach irritation in some individuals.
  • Rest and Relax: Stress and physical exertion may sometimes make abdominal discomfort feel worse. Gentle rest and relaxation techniques may help ease symptoms.
  • Avoid Alcohol and Smoking: Alcohol and tobacco products can irritate the digestive system and may worsen stomach discomfort.
  • Monitor Your Symptoms: Keep track of when the pain occurs and whether it is related to meals or medicine intake. This information may be helpful when discussing symptoms with your healthcare provider.
  • Seek Medical Advice if Needed: Consult a healthcare professional if stomach pain is severe, persistent, worsening, or accompanied by symptoms such as vomiting, fever, or blood in the stool.

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

Consult your doctor

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician after evaluating the risk and benefits. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. `

Breastfeeding

Consult your doctor

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.

Driving and Using Machines

Use with Caution

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet may cause excessive sleepiness or tiredness. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet. 

Alcohol

Contraindicated

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet, as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Kidney

Consult your doctor

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet is not recommended for use in patients with kidney failure. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems.

Liver

Use with Caution

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet should be used with caution in patients with liver problems.

Allergy

Contraindicated

Do not take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet if you are allergic to levocetirizine or to any other antihistamines (Ex. cetirizine, hydroxyzine).

Use In Pediatrics

Consult your doctor

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet should be used in children and adolescents (aged 6 years or above) only if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. 

Use In Geriatrics

Use with Caution

Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Other Warnings for LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

Before taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet, inform your doctor if you:

  • suffer from epilepsy (fits) or are at risk of developing convulsions
  • are unable to pass urine (due to spinal cord injury or due to enlarged prostate)
  • are scheduled for any allergic testing

Safety Advice

  • Take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet only in the dose and duration recommended by your healthcare professional.
  • This medicine may cause drowsiness, dizziness, or fatigue in some individuals. Avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel less alert.
  • Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may increase sleepiness and impair concentration.
  • Inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, urinary retention, epilepsy, or any other ongoing medical condition before starting the medicine.
  • Consult your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding.
  • Do not stop or change the dosage without medical advice.
  • Inform your doctor about all prescription medicines, over-the-counter products, and supplements you are taking to avoid potential interactions.
  • Seek medical attention if you experience signs of a severe allergic reaction, such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or difficulty breathing.
  • Keep the medicine out of the reach of children and store it in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

Diet and Lifestyle Advice

  • Identify and minimize exposure to common allergy triggers such as dust, pollen, pet dander, mold, and smoke whenever possible.
  • Keep your living space clean by vacuuming regularly, washing bedding frequently, and reducing dust accumulation.
  • Stay well-hydrated throughout the day to help maintain overall respiratory and nasal comfort.
  • Include a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and antioxidant-containing foods to support overall well-being.
  • During high pollen seasons, keep windows closed and consider using air purifiers to reduce indoor allergen exposure.
  • Shower and change clothes after spending time outdoors to remove pollen and other environmental allergens from your skin and hair.
  • Avoid smoking and limit exposure to secondhand smoke, as it may worsen allergy-related discomfort.
  • Ensure adequate sleep and manage stress through relaxation techniques, as stress may contribute to increased sensitivity to allergens in some individuals.
  • Follow your healthcare provider's advice regarding allergy management and medicine use for optimal results.

Drug - Drug interaction

1. Sedatives and Sleeping Pills (e.g., zolpidem, diazepam, alprazolam)

Interaction: Taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet with sedatives, sleeping pills, or anti-anxiety medicines may increase drowsiness, dizziness, and reduced alertness.

Management: Use these medicines together only if advised by your doctor. Avoid activities requiring mental alertness, such as driving or operating machinery, until you know how the combination affects you.
