FAQs About LEVOCETRIZEN 10MG TABLET

Q: What is Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet used for?

A: Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet is commonly used to help manage symptoms associated with allergic conditions, such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and hives. It contains levocetirizine, an antihistamine that works by blocking histamine activity in the body.

Q: How does Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet work?

A: Levocetirizine helps reduce the effects of histamine, a substance released during allergic reactions. This action helps ease symptoms such as itching, sneezing, and watery eyes.

Q: When should I take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet?

A: It is usually taken once daily, preferably in the evening or as directed by your healthcare professional. Try to take it at the same time each day for consistent results.

Q: Can I take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet with food?

A: Yes, Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet can be taken with or without food. Food does not significantly affect how the medicine works.

Q: Does Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet cause drowsiness?

A: Some people may experience drowsiness, fatigue, or dizziness while taking this medicine. If affected, avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how it impacts you.

Q: Can I consume alcohol while taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet?

A: Alcohol may increase drowsiness and reduce alertness when taken with levocetirizine. It is advisable to avoid or limit alcohol consumption during use.

Q: Is Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet suitable for children?

A: This medicine may be prescribed for children based on their age, weight, and medical condition. Always follow the dosage instructions provided by a healthcare professional.

Q: What should I do if I miss a dose?

A: Take the missed dose as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.

Q: Can Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet be used during pregnancy?

A: If you are pregnant or planning a pregnancy, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Your healthcare provider will assess whether it is appropriate for your individual situation.

Q: Can I take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet while breastfeeding?

A: Small amounts of levocetirizine may pass into breast milk. Consult your healthcare professional before using this medicine while breastfeeding.

Q: What are the common side effects of Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet?

A: Commonly reported side effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, headache, fatigue, and dizziness. These effects are generally mild and may improve as your body adjusts to the medicine.

Q: Can I take Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet with other medicines?

A: Certain medicines, especially sedatives, sleeping pills, and alcohol, may increase drowsiness when used with levocetirizine. Inform your doctor about all medicines and supplements you are taking.

Q: How should I store Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet?

A: Store the tablets in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep them out of the reach of children and pets.

Q: Who should consult a doctor before taking Levocetrizen 10mg Tablet?

A: Individuals with kidney problems, urinary retention, epilepsy, or other ongoing medical conditions should seek medical advice before starting this medicine. This helps ensure safe and appropriate use.

Introduction About CETCIP 10MG TABLET

Cetcip 10mg Tablet (Cetirizine) is an antihistamine commonly used when allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny or blocked nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching are affecting day-to-day comfort. It may be particularly useful for adults and adolescents who experience symptoms associated with seasonal or other allergies, as well as certain itchy skin conditions such as hives. Cetirizine works by reducing the effects of histamine, a chemical involved in allergic reactions. It is generally considered a less-sedating antihistamine than some older medicines, although drowsiness can still occur in some people.

For adults and children aged 12 years and above, the usual cetirizine dose is 10 mg once daily, unless a doctor recommends otherwise. Cetcip 10mg Tablet can generally be taken with or without food and should be swallowed whole with water. People with kidney problems may require a different dose, so medical advice is important before using this group. The medicine should be taken according to the product label or healthcare professional's directions, and a missed dose should not be compensated for by taking two doses together.

Before taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have kidney or liver problems, epilepsy or a history of seizures, difficulty passing urine, or a previous allergic reaction to cetirizine or related medicines. Extra caution is advisable when taking medicines that can cause sleepiness, including sedatives or tranquillizers, because their effects may be increased. Alcohol may also add to drowsiness. Avoid driving, cycling or operating machinery if you feel sleepy, dizzy or less alert after taking cetirizine.

If you are pregnant, discuss the use of Cetcip 10mg Tablet with your doctor or pharmacist before starting it. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before Cetcip 10mg Tablet. Common side effects may include sleepiness or tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, dizziness and diarrhoea. Seek urgent medical attention if signs of a serious allergic reaction, such as swelling of the lips, mouth or throat or difficulty breathing, occur.

Uses Of CETCIP 10MG TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 6 years or above) to manage symptoms associated with

  • Allergic rhinitis (such as nasal congestion, itchy nose, repeated sneezing and red, watery and itchy eyes)
  • Chronic Idiopathic Urticaria (severe skin rash with reddish raised patches and itching)

Benefits of CETCIP 10MG TABLET

Provides Effective Relief From Common Allergy Symptoms

Cetcip 10mg Tablet helps relieve common allergy symptoms caused by allergens such as dust, pollen, pet dander, and other environmental triggers. It helps reduce allergy-related discomfort and supports greater comfort during daily activities.

Helps Relieve Sneezing, Runny Nose and Nasal Irritation

Cetcip 10mg Tablet helps reduce allergy-related sneezing, runny nose, and nasal irritation. By controlling these symptoms, it can help make nasal breathing more comfortable and reduce disruption to your everyday routine.

Reduces Itching and Watering of the Eyes Due to Allergies

Allergies may cause itchy, watery, and irritated eyes. Cetcip 10mg Tablet helps relieve these allergy-related symptoms, helping reduce eye discomfort associated with exposure to common allergens.

Helps Control Multiple Symptoms Associated With Allergic Rhinitis

Cetcip 10mg Tablet helps manage multiple symptoms of allergic rhinitis, including sneezing, runny nose, nasal irritation, and itching. It helps provide relief from the discomfort associated with allergic conditions.

How CETCIP 10MG TABLET Works

Blocks Histamine H1 Receptors to Reduce Allergy Symptoms

Cetcip 10mg Tablet contains cetirizine, an antihistamine that works by blocking histamine H1 receptors. Histamine is a chemical released by the body during an allergic reaction and is responsible for symptoms such as sneezing, itching, runny nose, and watery eyes. By blocking its action, Cetcip 10mg Tablet helps reduce these allergy symptoms.

Helps Prevent Histamine From Triggering Allergic Reactions

Cetcip 10mg Tablet reduces the effects of histamine by preventing it from effectively activating H1 receptors. This helps control the body's response to allergens and reduces common symptoms associated with allergic reactions, including nasal irritation, sneezing, itching, and watery eyes.

Reduces the Effects of Histamine Responsible for Allergy Symptoms

Cetcip 10mg Tablet works by limiting the action of histamine at H1 receptors in the body. This helps reduce histamine-related symptoms such as itching, sneezing, runny nose, and watery eyes, providing relief from discomfort associated with allergic conditions.

How to use CETCIP 10MG TABLET

How to take Cetcip 10mg Tablet

  • Take Cetcip 10mg Tablet exactly as prescribed or recommended by your doctor.
  • Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or break it unless advised by your doctor.
  • Cetcip 10mg Tablet may be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time each day.
  • Do not take more than the recommended dose, even if your allergy symptoms do not improve immediately.
  • If you miss a dose, take it when you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose.
  • Follow your doctor's recommended duration of treatment and do not stop the medicine without medical advice.

What if I forgot to take CETCIP 10MG TABLET

If you forget to take Cetcip 10mg Tablet, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one. If you frequently forget your doses, consult your doctor or pharmacist for guidance.

Overdose

Taking more than the recommended dose of Cetcip 10mg Tablet may increase the risk of side effects, such as excessive drowsiness, restlessness, or other unwanted symptoms. If you accidentally take more than the prescribed dose, seek medical attention promptly. Do not take an additional dose to compensate for any missed dose, and consult your doctor or pharmacist for appropriate guidance.

Side Effects Of CETCIP 10MG TABLET

Common side effects of Cetcip 10mg Tablet

  • sleepiness/drowsiness
  • headache, dizziness
  • dry mouth, nausea, diarrhea
  • tiredness
  • sore throat, inflammation of nasal tract

Stop taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects such as

  • signs of allergic reaction (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue and/or throat which can lead to difficulty in breathing or swallowing, sudden fall in blood pressure, feeling faint, shock)
  • fits (seizures)
  • suicidal thoughts or behavior

How To Manage Side Effects

Diarrhea

Drink plenty of fluids, such as water or fruit juice to keep yourself hydrated. Consuming ORS can also be beneficial. Do not consume any medicine on your own without consulting your doctor. If your diarrhea worsens, contact your doctor.

Dizziness Or Drowsiness

Try to rest and relax. Get enough sleep. Avoid driving or operating any tools or machines completely while you are feeling sleepy. Do not consume excessive alcohol, as it could aggravate your sleepiness. Consult your doctor if your condition worsens.

Dry Mouth

Drink plenty of water and fruit juices. Consume foods which has high water and fiber content. Artificial saliva can also be used in extreme dryness of mouth. If your condition worsens, contact your doctor.

Headache

Rest and relax. Keep yourself hydrated by drinking plenty of fluids such as water or electrolytes. Applying a pain-relieving balm on your forehead can be beneficial. Do not consume excessive alcohol, as it could aggravate your headache. Consult your doctor if your headache worsens.

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

Consult your doctor

Cetcip 10mg Tablet should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. 

Breastfeeding

Consult your doctor

Cetcip 10mg Tablet may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.

Driving and Using Machines

Use with Caution

Cetcip 10mg Tablet may cause excessive sleepiness or tiredness. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by Cetcip 10mg Tablet .

Alcohol

Contraindicated

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet  as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Kidney

Consult your doctor

Cetcip 10mg Tablet is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease (such as kidney failure). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

Use with Caution

Cetcip 10mg Tablet  should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy

Contraindicated

Do not take Cetcip 10mg Tablet if you are allergic to Cetirizine or to any other anti-allergic medicines (such as hydroxyzine, levocetirizine, meclozine, cyclizine, buclizine).

Use In Pediatrics

Consult your doctor

Cetcip 10mg Tablet  should be used in children and adolescents (aged 6 years or above) only if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use In Geriatrics

Use with Caution

Cetcip 10mg Tablet should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Other Warnings for CETCIP 10MG TABLET

Before taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet, inform your doctor if you

  • suffer from epilepsy (fits) or are at risk of developing convulsions
  • are unable to pass urine (due to spinal cord injury or due to enlarged prostate)
  • are scheduled for any allergic testing

Safety Advice

  • Cetirizine can cause drowsiness or reduced alertness in some people. Avoid driving or operating machinery if you experience these effects.
  • Avoid or limit alcohol while taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet, as it may increase drowsiness.
  • Inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, as a dose adjustment may be needed.
  • Tell your doctor if you have epilepsy or a history of seizures before taking cetirizine.
  • Inform your doctor if you have difficulty passing urine.
  • If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet.
  • Tell your doctor or pharmacist about medicines that may cause drowsiness, as their effects may increase when taken with cetirizine.

Diet and Lifestyle Advice

  • Identify and minimize exposure to known allergy triggers such as dust, pollen, pet dander or other substances that commonly worsen your symptoms.
  • Keep your living and sleeping areas clean and well-ventilated to reduce exposure to common airborne allergens.
  • During periods of high pollen exposure, consider keeping windows closed and changing clothes after spending time outdoors.
  • Stay adequately hydrated, particularly if you experience a dry mouth while taking cetirizine.
  • Avoid alcohol if cetirizine makes you feel sleepy or less alert.
  • Maintain regular sleep habits if allergy symptoms or cetirizine-related drowsiness affect your usual routine.
  • Do not make major dietary restrictions solely because you have allergies unless a specific food trigger has been identified or advised by a healthcare professional.

Drug - Drug interaction

1. CNS Depressants (e.g., sleeping pills, sedatives, opioids)

  • Interaction: These substances can enhance the central nervous system (CNS)-depressant effects of Cetcip 10mg Tablet.
  • Effect: The combination may increase drowsiness, dizziness, reduced alertness, and impaired coordination.
  • Management: Avoid or limit alcohol and use caution with other medicines that cause drowsiness. Patients should avoid driving or operating machinery if they feel sleepy.  

2. Theophylline

  • Interaction: Theophylline may slightly reduce the clearance of cetirizine from the body.
  • Effect: This may result in a slight increase in cetirizine exposure, although the interaction is generally not considered clinically significant.
  • Management: Usually, no dose adjustment is required. Monitor for increased cetirizine-related adverse effects such as drowsiness.  

3. Other Antihistamines (e.g., diphenhydramine, chlorpheniramine)

  • Interaction: Taking multiple antihistamines together can produce additive antihistaminic and CNS-depressant effects.
  • Effect: The combination may increase drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, and impaired alertness.
  • Management: Avoid combining cetirizine with other antihistamines unless specifically recommended by a healthcare professional.

4. Sedative or Anxiolytic Medicines (e.g., benzodiazepines such as diazepam or alprazolam)

  • Interaction: These medicines can enhance the sedative effects of cetirizine.
  • Effect: Combined use may increase sleepiness, dizziness, and impairment of psychomotor performance.
  • Management: Use cautiously under medical supervision. Patients should avoid driving or other activities requiring full alertness if excessive drowsiness occurs.

5. Other Medicines That Cause Drowsiness (e.g., certain antidepressants, antipsychotics, or muscle relaxants)

  • Interaction: Medicines with sedative properties may have additive effects when taken with Cetcip 10mg Tablet.
  • Effect: This may increase drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, and reduced concentration.
  • Management: Inform the doctor or pharmacist about all medicines being taken. Monitor for excessive sedation and avoid driving if affected.

Drug - Food interaction

1. Alcohol

  • Effect: Taking cetirizine with alcohol may increase drowsiness, dizziness, and reduced alertness.
  • Management: Avoid or limit alcohol while taking CETCIP 10 mg Tablet, particularly if it causes drowsiness.

FAQs About CETCIP 10MG TABLET

Q: What is Cetcip 10mg Tablet used for?

A: Cetcip 10mg Tablet contains cetirizine, an antihistamine used to relieve common allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching. It may also be used for symptoms associated with hives. Use it according to your doctor's advice or the product directions.

Q: How does Cetcip 10mg Tablet work?

A: Cetcip 10mg Tablet contains cetirizine, which works by blocking the action of histamine in the body. Histamine is one of the chemicals involved in many allergic symptoms. By reducing its effects, cetirizine can help relieve symptoms such as itching, sneezing and a runny nose.

Q: How should I take Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: Take Cetcip 10mg Tablet in the dose and frequency recommended by your doctor. It can generally be taken with or without food and should be swallowed with water. Do not take more than the recommended amount.

Q: When is the best time to take Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: Cetcip 10mg Tablet can generally be taken at any time of the day, but taking it at the same time each day can help you remember your dose. If cetirizine makes you sleepy, taking it in the evening may be more convenient. Follow your doctor's instructions if a specific timing has been advised.

Q: Can Cetcip 10mg Tablet cause sleepiness?

A: Yes, some people may experience drowsiness or tiredness after taking cetirizine. Avoid driving, cycling or operating machinery if you feel sleepy or less alert. Alcohol may increase drowsiness and should preferably be avoided.

Q: Can I take Cetcip 10mg Tablet every day?

A: Cetirizine may be taken regularly when recommended by a doctor for ongoing allergy symptoms. The appropriate duration depends on your symptoms and individual circumstances. Do not continue taking it for longer than recommended without discussing it with a healthcare professional.

Q: Can Cetcip 10mg Tablet be taken with food?

A: Yes, Cetcip 10mg Tablet can generally be taken with or without food. Take the tablet with water and swallow it whole unless your product packaging provides different instructions. Food does not usually prevent cetirizine from working.

Q: What should I do if I miss a dose of Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: Take the missed dose when you remember unless it is nearly time for your next scheduled dose. If the next dose is due soon, skip the missed dose and continue with your usual schedule. Do not take two doses together to make up for a missed dose.

Q: Can Cetcip 10mg Tablet be taken during pregnancy?

A: If you are pregnant, consult your doctor before taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet. Your doctor can consider your symptoms, medical history and the available options before recommending cetirizine. Do not start or stop an allergy medicine during pregnancy without professional advice.

Q: Can I take Cetcip 10mg Tablet while breastfeeding?

A: If you are breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking Cetcip 10mg Tablet. Cetirizine is generally considered one of the preferred antihistamines during breastfeeding, but individual advice is still recommended. Monitor the baby for unusual sleepiness or feeding difficulties if advised to use it.

Q: What are the common side effects of Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: Common side effects may include sleepiness, tiredness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, dizziness or diarrhoea. These effects are often mild and may improve as your body adjusts to the medicine. Contact your doctor if they persist, become troublesome or worsen.

Q: Can Cetcip 10mg Tablet be taken with other medicines?

A: Tell your doctor or pharmacist about all medicines, supplements and herbal products you currently take. Particular caution may be needed with medicines that can cause drowsiness, as their effects may become stronger when combined with cetirizine. Follow professional advice before combining medicines.

Q: Who should take extra care when using Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: Tell your doctor before using cetirizine if you have kidney problems, epilepsy or a history of seizures, difficulty passing urine, or a previous allergy to cetirizine or related medicines. Your doctor may need to adjust the dose or consider whether cetirizine is appropriate for you. Children should receive age-appropriate dosing as advised by a healthcare professional.

Q: What should I do if I take too much Cetcip 10mg Tablet?

A: If you accidentally take more than the recommended dose, seek medical advice, particularly if you develop marked drowsiness or unusual symptoms. Do not take another dose to compensate for the extra amount. Keep the medicine packaging available when seeking advice so the product and strength can be identified.

Introduction About SINAREST NEW TABLET

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of fluids such as water, coconut water, or lemon water. Dehydration is a common cause of dizziness.
  • Eat Small, Frequent Meals: Low blood sugar may trigger dizziness. Eat balanced meals with complex carbs, proteins, and fruits.
  • Avoid Sudden Movements: Stand up slowly from sitting or lying positions to prevent a drop in blood pressure that can cause light-headedness.
  • Get Fresh Air: Step outside or open a window to improve oxygen flow and reduce feelings of giddiness.
  • Reduce Caffeine and Alcohol: Both can cause dehydration or affect blood circulation, increasing dizziness episodes.
  • Deep Breathing or Relaxation: Gentle breathing exercises can calm your nervous system and improve oxygen flow.
  • Monitor Medications: Some medicines can cause dizziness as a side effect if it occurs often, consult your healthcare professional for guidance.

Nausea And Vomiting

  • Ginger: Ginger tea, ginger water, or a small piece of fresh ginger can help calm the stomach and reduce the urge to vomit.
  • Lemon: Sipping warm lemon water or smelling fresh lemon may help ease nausea and freshen the stomach.
  • Mint (Pudina): Mint tea or chewing fresh mint leaves may help soothe the stomach and reduce queasiness.
  • Cold Water or Ice Chips: Taking small sips of cold water or sucking on ice chips can help reduce nausea.
  • Fennel Seeds (Saunf): Chewing fennel seeds or drinking fennel seed water may help relieve nausea and bloating.
  • Clove: Sucking on a clove or drinking clove tea can help reduce the uneasy feeling in the stomach.

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

Consult your doctor

Sinarest New Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if clearly advised by your doctor. Always consult your healthcare professional before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or think you may be pregnant. 

Breastfeeding

Use with Caution

Sinarest New Tablet should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as some of its components may pass into breast milk and affect the baby. Consult your doctor before using this medicine while nursing. 

Driving and Using Machines

Contraindicated

Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery after taking Sinarest New Tablet if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, or blurred vision, as these effects may reduce alertness. 

Alcohol

Use with Caution

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking Sinarest New Tablet. Alcohol may increase drowsiness and can raise the risk of liver-related side effects. 

Kidney

Use with Caution

Sinarest New Tablet should be used with caution in individuals with kidney-related conditions. Consult your doctor before use, especially if you have a history of kidney problems.  

Liver

Use with Caution

Patients with liver disorders should take Sinarest New Tablet with caution. Since it contains paracetamol, excessive use may affect liver function. Medical supervision is recommended. 

Allergy

Contraindicated

Do not take Sinarest New Tablet if you are allergic to paracetamol, phenylephrine, chlorpheniramine, or any of its components. Inform your doctor immediately if you develop rash, itching, swelling, or breathing difficulty.

Lungs

Consult your doctor

Sinarest New Tablet is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems like emphysema or chronic bronchitis. It should be used with caution in patients with other breathing problems, like asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Heart Disease

Use with Caution

Sinarest New Tablet should be used with caution in people with heart conditions or high blood pressure, as the decongestant component may affect heart rate and blood pressure. Medical advice is essential.  

Use In Pediatrics

Contraindicated

Sinarest New Tablet is not recommended for use in young children unless specifically prescribed by a doctor. Consult your doctor for advice. 

Use In Geriatrics

Use with Caution

Elderly patients (65 years and above) should use Sinarest New Tablet with caution, as they may be more sensitive to side effects such as drowsiness, dizziness, or changes in blood pressure. 

Other Warnings for SINAREST NEW TABLET

Before taking Sinarest New Tablet, inform your doctor if you

  • Have glaucoma, Thyroid disorders, Prostate enlargement

Safety Advice

  • Use only as prescribed: Take Sinarest New Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor or as mentioned on the label. Do not exceed the recommended dose or duration.
  • Avoid multiple paracetamol products: Do not take other medicines containing paracetamol at the same time, as this may increase the risk of liver-related side effects.
  • Short-term use only: Sinarest New Tablet is meant for temporary relief. If symptoms persist for more than a few days, consult your doctor.
  • Medical conditions: Inform your doctor if you have liver disease, heart problems, high blood pressure, glaucoma, thyroid disorders, or prostate enlargement before taking this medicine.

Diet and Lifestyle Advice

  • Stay well hydrated: Drink plenty of warm fluids such as water, soups, or herbal teas to help soothe the throat and reduce nasal congestion.
  • Eat light, nutritious meals: Choose easily digestible foods like fruits, vegetables, soups, and whole grains. Avoid heavy, oily, or very spicy foods that may cause stomach discomfort.
  • Limit caffeine intake: Excess tea, coffee, or energy drinks may worsen restlessness or interfere with proper rest during illness.
  • Get adequate rest: Proper sleep and rest help the body recover faster from cold and flu symptoms. Avoid overexertion while unwell.
  • Avoid smoking: Smoking can irritate the airways and worsen cough, throat irritation, and nasal symptoms.
  • Maintain good hygiene: Wash hands frequently, use tissues when sneezing or coughing, and avoid close contact with others to prevent spreading infection.
  • Use steam inhalation if advised: Warm steam may help relieve nasal blockage and improve breathing comfort.
  • Take the medicine as directed: Follow the prescribed schedule and duration for best results and to avoid unnecessary side effects.

Drug - Drug interaction

1. Interaction with Other Paracetamol-Containing Medicines

Interaction: Taking Sinarest New Tablet along with other medicines that contain paracetamol can lead to excessive paracetamol intake, increasing the risk of liver damage.
Management: Avoid using multiple cold, flu, or pain medicines together unless advised by your doctor. Always check medicine labels for paracetamol content.

2. Interaction with Sedatives and Sleep Medicines (e.g., Benzodiazepines)

Interaction: Combining Sinarest New Tablet with sedatives, sleeping pills, or anti-anxiety medicines may cause excessive drowsiness, dizziness, or reduced alertness.
Management: Use only under medical advice. Avoid driving or operating machinery if such combinations are necessary.

3. Interaction with Antidepressants (MAO Inhibitors and Tricyclic Antidepressants)

Interaction: Certain antidepressants may enhance the effects of phenylephrine, leading to increased blood pressure, headache, or palpitations.
Management: Sinarest New Tablet should generally be avoided or used with caution if you are taking antidepressants. Inform your doctor before use.

4. Interaction with Blood Pressure Medicines

Interaction: Phenylephrine may reduce the effectiveness of some blood pressure–lowering medicines or cause a rise in blood pressure.
Management: Patients with hypertension should use Sinarest New Tablet only after consulting a doctor and monitor blood pressure regularly.

5. Interaction with Antihistamines or Allergy Medicines

Interaction: Using additional antihistamines with Sinarest New Tablet may increase side effects such as drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, or urinary retention.
Management: Avoid combining multiple antihistamine products unless advised by a healthcare professional.

6. Interaction with Antiepileptic Medicines (e.g., Phenytoin, Carbamazepine)

Interaction: These medicines may increase the breakdown of paracetamol, potentially raising the risk of liver toxicity with prolonged use.
Management: Use under medical supervision, especially in long-term therapy or patients with liver risk factors.

7. Interaction with Anticholinergic Medicines

Interaction: Combined use may worsen side effects such as dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, or difficulty in urination.
Management: Inform your doctor if you are taking medicines for bladder problems, Parkinson’s disease, or gastrointestinal conditions.

8. Interaction with Herbal Supplements (e.g., St John’s Wort)

Interaction: Some herbal products may affect liver enzymes and alter how paracetamol is processed in the body.
Management: Always disclose herbal or natural supplements to your doctor before taking Sinarest New Tablet.

Drug - Food interaction

1. Interaction with Caffeine-Containing Beverages (Tea, Coffee, Energy Drinks)

Interaction: Excess caffeine may increase restlessness, nervousness, or palpitations, especially when combined with phenylephrine.
Management: Limit caffeine intake and opt for non-caffeinated drinks like herbal teas or warm water.

2. Interaction with High-Fat Meals

Interaction: Heavy or fatty meals may delay the absorption of the medicine, slowing the onset of symptom relief.
Management: Take the tablet after a light or balanced meal rather than a very heavy or oily one.

3. Interaction with Grapefruit or Grapefruit Juice

Interaction: Grapefruit may interfere with the metabolism of some medicines and could potentially alter the effects of antihistamines.
Management: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice while using Sinarest New Tablet.

4. Interaction with Spicy or Irritating Foods

Interaction: Very spicy foods may worsen stomach irritation or nausea, which can be a side effect of the medicine.
Management: Choose mild, easily digestible foods during the course of treatment.

5. Interaction with High-Sugar or Processed Foods

Interaction: Excessive sugary or processed foods may contribute to fatigue and reduce overall comfort during illness.
Management: Focus on fresh, whole foods such as fruits, vegetables, and soups to support recovery.

6. Interaction with Cold or Iced Foods and Drinks

Interaction: Cold foods or beverages may irritate the throat and worsen cold symptoms in some individuals.
Management: Prefer warm fluids and foods to soothe the throat and nasal passages.

7. Interaction with Herbal Teas or Supplements

Interaction: Certain herbal products may increase drowsiness or affect liver function when combined with Sinarest New Tablet.
Management: Avoid starting new herbal supplements during treatment and inform your doctor about any ongoing herbal use.

FAQs About SINAREST NEW TABLET

Q: What is Sinarest New Tablet used for?

A: Sinarest New Tablet is commonly used to relieve symptoms associated with the common cold, flu, and seasonal allergies. It helps reduce fever, headache, body aches, nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and watery eyes. By addressing multiple symptoms together, it improves overall comfort during short-term respiratory illnesses.

Q: How should Sinarest New Tablet be taken?

A: Take Sinarest New Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water, preferably after food to reduce stomach discomfort. Do not crush or chew the tablet. The dose and duration depend on your age, symptoms, and overall health condition.

Q: What are the possible side effects of Sinarest New Tablet?

A: Some individuals may experience mild side effects such as drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, stomach discomfort, or headache. These effects are usually temporary. If any side effect becomes severe or persistent, consult your doctor promptly.

Q: Can Sinarest New Tablet be used during pregnancy?

A: Sinarest New Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if your doctor considers it necessary. Always consult a healthcare professional before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant.

Q: What precautions should be taken while using Sinarest New Tablet?

A: Use Sinarest New Tablet with caution if you have liver disease, heart problems, high blood pressure, glaucoma, thyroid disorders, or prostate enlargement. Avoid alcohol and do not take other paracetamol-containing medicines at the same time unless advised by your doctor.

Q: Who should avoid Sinarest New Tablet?

A: Avoid Sinarest New Tablet if you are allergic to paracetamol, phenylephrine, chlorpheniramine, or any of its components. It is also not recommended for people with severe liver disease or those advised by their doctor to avoid decongestants or antihistamines.

Q: Can Sinarest New Tablet cause drowsiness?

A: Yes, Sinarest New Tablet may cause drowsiness due to its antihistamine component. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or tasks requiring alertness if you feel sleepy after taking the tablet.

Q: Does Sinarest New Tablet affect blood pressure?

A: Sinarest New Tablet may slightly increase blood pressure in some individuals because of its decongestant component. People with high blood pressure should use it only after consulting a doctor.

Q: Can I take other medicines along with Sinarest New Tablet?

A: Before taking Sinarest New Tablet, inform your doctor about all other medicines you are using, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter products, or herbal supplements. This helps prevent potential interactions and ensures safe use.

Q: Can Sinarest New Tablet cause weight gain?

A: It contains paracetamol, phenylephrine, and chlorpheniramine, which do not directly affect body weight. The medicine is usually taken for a short period to manage cold and flu symptoms. Some people may feel drowsy or less active during illness, but this does not lead to weight gain. If you notice unusual weight changes, consult your doctor for proper evaluation.

Introduction About PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET.

Uses Of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

  • relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
  • lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu

How PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET Works

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

How to use PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

Take PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Side Effects Of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

Rare

  • reduced white blood cells (infections are more likely to occur)

Stop taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

  • allergic reaction (swelling of the hands, feet, ankles, face, lips or throat which may cause trouble swallowing or breathing, an itchy, lumpy rash or nettle rash, runny nose)

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.

Alcohol

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Kidney

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy

Do not take PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

  • have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
  • are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:             

  • other medicines containing paracetamol
  • medicines to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone)
  • cholestyramine (used to control blood lipid levels)
  • warfarin (used for managing blood clots)
  • medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. rifampicin, flucloxacillin, chloramphenicol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital, even if you feel well, as it can cause delayed, serious liver damage.

Drug :   Paracetamol
Pharmacological Category :   Para aminophenol derivative
Therapeutic Indication :   Pain, Fever
Dosage Forms :   Tablet, Dispersible tablet, Drops, Syrup, Oral suspension, Liquid, Oral solution, Suppositories, Infusion, Injection

  • Keep PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET out of reach of children
  • Store below 25°C

FAQs About PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

Q: What is the use of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET?

A: PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever. It contains paracetamol (acetaminophen) and is often used for conditions like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, associated with various illnesses.

Q: What happens if I take PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET?

A: PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET contains a medicine called paracetamol which is an analgesic and antipyretic agent. Following administration, it works by blocking the release of certain chemicals called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Paracetamol also manages the release of such chemicals in the hypothalamus of the brain which helps in controlling fever.

Q: Can I take two doses of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET in a day?

A: The dosage of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET is decided by your physician. However, studies have shown that taking paracetamol once in every 4-6 hours significantly reduced fever and body pains.

Q: Can we use PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET for cold?

A: PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET could be used in the management of sore throat and body pains that is associated with common cold. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which is commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain, like headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, and fever associated with various illnesses.

Q. Can I take PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET as often as required?

A: The dosage of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET and duration of the therapy would be decided by your doctor. It is usually not recommended to take more than 4 doses of PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET in a day. Leave a time gap of 4-6 hours, between each dose.

Introduction About ZERODOL-SP TABLET

ZERODOL-SP TABLET is a pain relief combination used to provide relief from pain, inflammation and swelling associated with joint pain, muscle pain, post-operative conditions, etc.

It contains a combination of Aceclofenac, paracetamol and serratiopeptidase as active ingredients. Aceclofenac and Paracetamol are pain relieving medicines which works by blocking the release of certain chemicals in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Serratiopeptidase is a protein-breaking enzyme which breaks down the abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the affected areas.

Before taking Zerodol-SP, inform your doctor if you have any stomach disease like ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease, bleedings or perforation in the gut, bloody stools or vomits, etc. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, liver, kidney or heart problems as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of Zerodol-SP are dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, mouth ulcers, increased liver enzymes in the blood, indigestion, bloating, stomach irritation, increase in blood urea or creatinine levels.

Uses Of ZERODOL-SP TABLET

How ZERODOL-SP TABLET Works

It contains a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase. Aceclofenac is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks the enzyme (COX) responsible for producing prostaglandins, chemicals in the body that cause pain and inflammation. By inhibiting this enzyme, aceclofenac reduces pain and swelling.

Paracetamol works by reducing the intensity of pain signals sent to the brain and helps regulate body temperature, acting as both a pain reliever and fever reducer. Serratiopeptidase is an enzyme that breaks down proteins involved in inflammation and promotes the removal of dead tissue, reducing swelling and improving healing.

Together, these components help reduce pain, inflammation, and swelling effectively in conditions like arthritis, muscle pain, and joint pain.

  • Do not chew or crush the medicine

This combination makes it stronger than medications containing only one type of pain-relief component.

Q: Can Zerodol SP be used for ear pain?

A: Zerodol SP may help relieve ear pain because of its anti-inflammatory properties, but it is not typically recommended for this type of pain without a doctor’s consultation. Ear pain can have various causes, such as infections or fluid buildup, which may require specific treatment beyond general pain relief. It’s best to consult a healthcare provider to determine if Zerodol SP is appropriate for your specific ear pain.

Q: Is Zerodol SP used for head pain?

A: Zerodol SP is generally not the first choice for headaches or migraines. It is designed to treat musculoskeletal pain, which involves inflammation and swelling of muscles and joints. Headaches and migraines are often managed with medications specifically formulated for those types of pain, such as paracetamol, ibuprofen, or migraine-specific drugs. Zerodol SP may not provide optimal relief for headaches and could have unnecessary components for that type of pain.

Q: Can Zerodol damage kidneys?

A: Long-term use of Zerodol SP can potentially damage the kidneys, especially in individuals with existing kidney conditions or those taking high doses for extended periods. Aceclofenac, an NSAID in Zerodol SP, can reduce blood flow to the kidneys, which may impair kidney function over time. It’s important to take this medication only as prescribed and to avoid long-term use without medical supervision. Regular kidney function monitoring is recommended if prolonged use is necessary.

Q: Is Zerodol SP bad for the liver?

A: Zerodol SP contains paracetamol, which can affect the liver, especially in high doses or with prolonged use. Excessive or prolonged intake of paracetamol can cause liver toxicity, so people with liver conditions should consult their doctor before using it. Following the prescribed dosage and avoiding other medications containing paracetamol while taking Zerodol SP are essential steps in protecting liver health.

Q: Does Zerodol SP make you sleepy?

A: Zerodol SP is generally not associated with causing drowsiness or sedation. However, individual responses to medications can vary, and some people might feel slightly sleepy or fatigued. If you notice significant drowsiness after taking Zerodol SP, it’s recommended to consult your doctor, as they may adjust your dosage or suggest alternative options.

Q: How many hours does Zerodol SP last?

A: Zerodol SP typically provides relief for about 6 to 8 hours, though the exact duration can vary depending on individual factors like metabolism, the severity of pain, and the condition being treated. For chronic conditions, your doctor may prescribe a specific dosage schedule to maintain consistent pain relief. Always follow the prescribed timing to prevent overlapping doses.

Q: Are Zerodol and Dolo 650 the same?

A: No, they are different medications. Zerodol SP is a combination of aceclofenac, serratiopeptidase, and paracetamol, providing anti-inflammatory, anti-swelling, and pain-relief effects. Dolo 650, on the other hand, contains only paracetamol, which is primarily used as a fever reducer and pain reliever for mild to moderate pain. While Dolo 650 can help relieve headaches, fevers, and mild pain, Zerodol SP is stronger and more effective for conditions involving significant inflammation and musculoskeletal pain.

Q: Can Zerodol be used for nerve pain?

A: Zerodol SP is not specifically used for nerve pain. Medications such as gabapentin or pregabalin are generally prescribed for nerve-related pain. Zerodol SP is more suitable for pain caused by inflammation, swelling, or injury. While it may help reduce inflammation-related pain, it is unlikely to address the underlying issues associated with nerve pain, so consulting a doctor for appropriate treatment is recommended.

Q: Does Zerodol SP cause constipation?

A: Constipation is not a common side effect of Zerodol SP, but some individuals may experience gastrointestinal side effects like constipation, stomach discomfort, or bloating. If you experience constipation, inform your doctor, as they may suggest dietary adjustments, hydration, or additional treatments to alleviate this side effect.

Q: Can Zerodol SP Tablet be taken by pregnant or breastfeeding women?

A: Zerodol SP is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Its components may pose a risk to the developing fetus or nursing child, potentially leading to adverse effects. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor for safer alternatives. Self-medicating with Zerodol SP during pregnancy or lactation should be avoided to protect maternal and child health.

Q: Can Zerodol SP Tablet be used in diabetic patients?

A: Diabetic patients should consult their doctor before taking Zerodol SP. Some components may interact with antidiabetic medications or affect blood sugar control. It's crucial for diabetic patients to inform their doctor about all the medications they are currently taking to avoid potential interactions. The doctor may recommend regular blood sugar monitoring or adjust the dosage to ensure safe use.

Introduction About PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

Pantop DSR Capsule is a dual-action formulation combining Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent. It is helpful for individuals who experience recurring gastric discomfort, acid build-up, post-meal bloating or frequent burping. It is especially beneficial for those with a pattern of acid-related issues that worsen on an empty stomach or after heavy meals. Whether due to irregular meal timings, dietary choices or stress-induced acidity, Pantop DSR is designed to support a more comfortable and regulated digestive experience.   

Pantoprazole works by reducing the production of excess stomach acid creating a balanced gastric environment, while Domperidone enhances stomach motility, helping move food and gas more efficiently through the digestive tract. It is generally suitable for adults who face frequent episodes of bloating, discomfort after meals, or acid-related unease, especially those with sedentary lifestyles or irregular eating patterns.

For optimal effectiveness, Pantop DSR Capsule is usually taken once daily before meals, ideally in the morning. It should be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing. Adherence to the recommended timing and dosage, as directed by a healthcare provider, ensures better symptom control. It is important to maintain a gap of at least 30–60 minutes between the capsule and any calcium, iron, or magnesium supplements, as these may interfere with absorption. Avoid consuming alcohol and spicy foods while on this capsule, as these can aggravate stomach acid levels.

Caution is advised in individuals with liver, kidney, or heart conditions. It is also important to consult a doctor before use in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as the safety of Domperidone is still under clinical evaluation in such groups. While generally well-tolerated, some users may experience dry mouth, headache, dizziness, or mild gastrointestinal disturbances such as loose stools or constipation. If any unusual or persistent symptoms occur, medical guidance should be sought promptly.

Uses Of PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

  • Manages acid build-up in the stomach
  • Reduces belching or reflux-like symptoms
  • Improves digestion timing and stomach emptying

Benefits of PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

1. Pantop DSR for acid regulation:

  • Pantop DSR Capsule is formulated to regulate stomach acid levels effectively. The Pantoprazole component of the capsule helps manage excessive acid secretion in the stomach, reducing discomfort caused by acid buildup. It works by inhibiting the proton pumps in the stomach which are responsible for acid production
  • When stomach acid is regulated it can alleviate symptoms like heartburn, gastric irritation and acid regurgitation especially after meals. This can lead to a more comfortable digestive experience throughout the day allowing you to enjoy your meals without worrying about discomfort or acid-related symptoms
  • Pantop DSR is typically taken before meals aligning with the body’s natural digestive cycle and supporting effective acid control throughout the day. It benefits are often felt quickly, especially for individuals who experience frequent acidity or acid reflux

2. Pantop DSR for gastric discomfort and bloating:

  • Pantop DSR Capsule supports individuals experiencing gastric discomfort such as a heavy stomach, bloating or fullness after meals. These symptoms often arise due to slow gastric emptying or excess acid buildup which can interfere with everyday comfort and affect appetite.
  • The capsule contains a combination of Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that helps manage acid levels in the stomach and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent that aids in enhancing gastric motility. Together they support a more balanced digestive process by helping food and gas move smoothly through the digestive tract
  • By promoting efficient stomach movement and maintaining an optimal environment in the digestive system, Pantop DSR helps in relieving bloating, gas pressure and post-meal heaviness. These benefits can help users feel lighter and more at ease after eating, contributing to better meal tolerance and overall digestive well-being.

3. Pantop DSR for managing acid reflux symptoms:

  • Acid reflux also known as gastroesophageal reflux occurs when stomach acid moves up into the esophagus, causing irritation and a burning sensation in the chest or throat. Pantop DSR Capsule can be helpful for those experiencing acid reflux-like symptoms, as the Pantoprazole in the capsule reduces stomach acid production managing it from reaching the esophagus
  • The combination of Pantoprazole and Domperidone not only controls acid levels but also helps improve stomach emptying which can manage the stomach from being overly full and reduce the likelihood of reflux. The dual-action formula works both to control excess stomach acid and to encourage smooth digestion which can help reduce regurgitation and discomfort caused by acid reflux
  • By managing acid reflux symptoms, Pantop DSR provides relief from frequent heartburn, a sore throat or discomfort while lying down. Consistent use before meals helps maintain stable acid levels and ensures digestive comfort

How PANTOP DSR CAPSULE Works

How Pantop DSR Capsule Supports Gastric Acid Regulation

The formulation is designed to act at two levels:

  • Regulation of Excess Stomach Acid: The capsule contains a component that helps reduce the volume and acidity of stomach secretions. This contributes to a more neutral internal environment, helping relieve common discomfort associated with hyperacidity
  • Improved Stomach Emptying: By supporting the movement of food through the stomach and into the intestines, this capsule helps reduce the sensation of heaviness, bloating, and fullness which is the common experiences related to delayed gastric emptying

The delayed-release property ensures that the active ingredients are released only when they reach specific areas of the gastrointestinal tract, helping minimize irritation and maximize their function.

How to use PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

1. Recommended Dosage for Pantop DSR Capsule

  • For most individuals, One capsule of Pantop DSR is sufficient to support digestive health and regulate gastric acid levels
  • Duration of use should also be determined by your doctor, based on your individual needs and response to the medication

2. How and when to take Pantop DSR Capsule

  • Pantop DSR Capsule is best taken once daily, ideally 30–60 minutes before a meal, for optimal effectiveness
  • Take it on an empty stomach: The capsule works most effectively when the stomach is empty, as it supports gastric acid regulation and digestive function
  • Swallow the capsule whole: Do not chew, crush, or break the capsule. This ensures that the active ingredients are released in the right area of your digestive system
  • Drink a full glass of water: This helps in swallowing the capsule and aids in the absorption of the active ingredients
  • Consistency is key: Take your capsule at the same time each day to maintain a consistent level of the medication in your system
  • Avoid taking it with high-fat meals or other substances that might alter its absorption rate

What if I forgot to take PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

If you happen to miss a dose of Pantop DSR follow the steps below to maintain consistent use:

  • Take the missed dose as soon as you remember, preferably before a meal if it is still early in the day
  • If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed one and continue with your regular dosing schedule
  • Do not take two capsules at the same time to make up for the missed dose, as this may increase the chance of unwanted side effects
  • To avoid missing doses in the future, consider using a reminder app, daily alarm, or pill organizer
  • Maintaining a consistent daily schedule supports the capsule’s effectiveness in promoting digestive balance

Overdose

Accidental or intentional overuse of Pantop DSR Capsule may lead to unwanted effects, particularly if taken in amounts exceeding the recommended dosage. While serious effects are uncommon with single extra doses, larger quantities may cause symptoms related to digestive or neurological imbalance.

Possible signs of overuse may include:

  • drowsiness or dizziness
  • increased heart rate or irregular heartbeat
  • unusual muscle movements or restlessness
  • stomach discomfort or bloating
  • nausea or dry mouth

Expert Advice:

  • If too many capsules are taken accidentally, seek immediate medical assistance or contact a nearby healthcare facility
  • Do not induce vomiting or attempt self-care without professional supervision
  • Always keep the medication in a safe, child-proof location to avoid accidental access

Side Effects Of PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

Common side effects of PANTOP DSR CAPSULE:

  • benign polyps in the stomach
  • dry mouth
  • headache
  • dizziness
  • drowsiness
  • diarrhea
  • constipation
  • stomach pain
  • flatulence

When to Seek Medical Attention?

  • severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the lips, face or body and difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
  • signs of liver problems (yellowing of the skin and eyes, dark urine and tiredness)
  • severe skin reactions (such as redness, blistering, peeling of skin and bleeding in the lips, eyes, mouth, nose and genitals with fever)
  • signs of kidney problem (such as lower back pain, painful urination)
  • signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat)
  • severe, persistent diarrhea
  • fast or irregular heartbeat, difficulty in breathing, feeling faint
  • fits
  • uncontrollable body movements (including eye and tongue), twisted neck and abnormal body posture

Warning & Precautions

Pregnancy

Monitoring required

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.  

Breastfeeding

Monitoring required

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.  

Driving and Using Machines

Use with Caution

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE does not affect your ability in driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by the medicine.

Alcohol

Consult your doctor

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PANTOP DSR CAPSULE, as it could aggravate your existing condition.

Kidney

Use with Caution

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems.

Liver

Consult your doctor

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems.

Allergy

Contraindicated

Do not take PANTOP DSR CAPSULE if you are allergic to Domperidone, Pantoprazole or to any other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease

Contraindicated

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as prolongation of QT interval or congestive heart failure.

Use In Pediatrics

Contraindicated

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).  

Use In Geriatrics

Use with Caution

PANTOP DSR CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

Other Warnings for PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

Before taking Pantop DSR Capsule inform your doctor if you:

  • have osteoporosis
  • have vitamin B12 deficiency
  • are going to test Chromogranin A level

Who should not take PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

Who should not take Pantop DSR Capsule

Pantop DSR Capsule is not recommended for use if you:

  • have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
  • have blockage or tear in the intestines
  • have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
  • have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
  • have low blood potassium or magnesium levels

Safety Advice

Expert Safety Advice for Pantop DSR Capsule

  • Use under the supervision of a registered healthcare professional, avoid prolonged self-use.
  • Take the capsule 30–60 minutes before food for optimal digestive support
  • Do not combine with grapefruit juice, alcohol, or high-fat meals to reduce absorption issues
  • Long-term use may require monitoring of magnesium, calcium, or vitamin B12 levels.
  • Caution advised if used alongside medicines that may affect the QT interval (e.g., antifungals, antibiotics)
  • Elderly individuals should use it with care due to higher risk of side effects
  • Do not double the dose if missed, take the next dose at the scheduled time
  • Limit or avoid smoking and alcohol to support better digestive balance
  • Consult a doctor if symptoms persist despite recommended use

Diet and Lifestyle Advice

1. Eat Small, Frequent Meals

  • Large meals can strain the digestive system and cause discomfort
  • Opt for smaller portions throughout the day to reduce bloating and maintain digestive ease

2. Choose Low-Acid, Non-Spicy Foods

  • Reduce intake of acidic foods like tomatoes, citrus fruits, and vinegar
  • Limit spicy, deep-fried, and oily foods that may irritate the stomach lining

3. Maintain Consistent Meal Timings

  • Irregular eating habits can increase digestive discomfort
  • Try to eat meals at the same time every day to support the natural rhythm of the digestive system

4. Avoid Lying Down Immediately After Eating

  • Wait at least 1.5 to 2 hours before lying down or going to bed after meals
  • This helps reduce upward movement of stomach contents and supports comfort.

5. Include Light Physical Activity

  • Gentle activities like walking can support digestive movement
  • Aim for 15–30 minutes of light activity after meals instead of being sedentary

6. Limit Caffeine and Carbonated Drinks

  • Beverages like coffee, soda, and energy drinks may increase stomach acid
  • Choose non-caffeinated, non-carbonated options like herbal teas or water

7. Avoid Smoking and Alcohol

  • Smoking and alcohol may aggravate digestive issues and reduce the comfort offered by this capsule
  • If possible, reduce or eliminate usage for better gut health

8. Manage Stress Levels

  • Stress can trigger digestive sensitivity and discomfort
  • Incorporate calming activities such as deep breathing, meditation to support overall digestive well-being

9. Stay Hydrated

  • Drink plenty of water throughout the day, especially between meals
  • Avoid drinking large quantities of water during meals, as it may interfere with digestion

Key Considerations Before Starting Pantop DSR Capsule

  • Before beginning Pantop DSR Capsule, it is important to share your complete medical history with your healthcare provider

Monitoring Digestive Health While on Pantop DSR

  • While using Pantop DSR, stay attentive to how your body responds, especially in the first few days. Keep track of improvements in symptoms like bloating, fullness, or acidity, as well as any new discomfort
  • If you notice persistent digestive issues or side effects, consult your doctor for guidance. Regular follow-ups help assess the ongoing need and ensure safe, sustained use

Drug - Drug interaction

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

1. Antifungal Medications (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Posaconazole)

  • Interaction: Reduced absorption of antifungals due to lower gastric acidity caused by Pantoprazole.
  • Management: Take antifungal medicines at least 2 hours before or 4–6 hours after Pantop DSR. Consult a doctor to adjust dosing or consider alternatives

2. HIV Protease Inhibitors (e.g., Atazanavir, Nelfinavir)

  • Interaction: Pantoprazole may reduce absorption, affecting the efficacy of the antiviral drug
  • Management: Avoid concurrent use unless necessary. Healthcare providers may adjust antiviral regimens or recommend alternatives not impacted by gastric pH

3. Anticoagulants (e.g., Warfarin, Clopidogrel)

  • Interaction: Pantoprazole and Domperidone may influence blood thinning activity, potentially altering bleeding risk
  • Management: Regular INR monitoring and dose adjustment by a healthcare professional is advised if used together

4. Antibiotics (e.g., Erythromycin)

  • Interaction: Erythromycin may increase Domperidone levels, potentially raising the risk of QT interval prolongation (cardiac rhythm concern)
  • Management: ECG monitoring may be considered in long-term or high-dose use. Inform your doctor of any dizziness or palpitations

5. Antidepressants & Antipsychotics (e.g., Fluoxetine, Sertraline, Haloperidol)

  • Interaction: When used with Domperidone, there may be an increased risk of cardiac side effects.
  • Management: Avoid combining with multiple QT-prolonging agents. Regular cardiac monitoring may be advised for sensitive individuals

6. Heart Rhythm Medicines (e.g., Amiodarone, Quinidine, Dofetilide)

  • Interaction: Concomitant use may enhance the risk of arrhythmias
  • Management: Only use under supervision. Dose adjustments or an ECG before and during use may be recommended

7. Mineral Supplements (e.g., Calcium, Iron, Magnesium)

  • Interaction: These may interfere with the absorption of Pantoprazole
  • Management: Maintain a gap of 2–4 hours between mineral supplements and Pantop DSR

Drug - Food interaction

1. Citrus Juices (Especially Grapefruit Juice)

  • Interaction: Grapefruit juice may inhibit the enzyme CYP3A4, leading to increased levels of Domperidone in the blood. This can heighten the risk of cardiac side effects (e.g., QT prolongation)
  • Management: Avoid grapefruit and related citrus juices while using Pantop DSR. Opt for water or non-citrus beverages when taking the capsule

3. Caffeine-Rich Beverages (e.g., Coffee, Energy Drinks)

  • Interaction: Excess caffeine may increase gastric acid secretion, which can reduce the capsule’s effectiveness in acid balance. It may also aggravate gastric symptoms like bloating or reflux-like discomfort
  • Management: Moderate caffeine intake and avoid taking the capsule with caffeinated drinks. Water is preferred for swallowing the capsule

4. Calcium, Iron, or Magnesium-Rich Foods

  • Interaction: These minerals can interfere with the absorption of Pantoprazole, especially when consumed close to medication timing
  • Management: Maintain a gap of at least 2 hours between such mineral-rich meals or supplements and Pantop DSR for optimal absorption

5. Spicy and Acidic Foods

  • Interaction: Spicy, acidic, or fried foods may exacerbate gastric irritation, countering the intended soothing effect of Pantop DSR
  • Management: Choose a bland, low-acid diet while on Pantop DSR to support digestive comfort and reduce recurrence of bloating or acidity

Introduction About DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET

DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET.

Uses Of DOLOPAR 650MG TABLET

  • relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)

Introduction About AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET

AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET manages mild to moderately susceptible infections caused by bacteria and other microorganisms, which include chest, throat, and nasal infections such as bronchitis, pneumonia, tonsillitis, sore throat, and sinusitis. It is also used to manage ear infections and skin and soft tissue infections in affected individuals.

It contains a medicine called azithromycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics that works by avoiding the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Azithromycin, other antibiotics such as erythromycin/clarithromycin (macrolides), and ketolides. It is also not recommended for use in patients with a history of cholestatic jaundice/hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, myasthenia gravis (a condition marked by weak muscles), heart problems, and/or kidney problems.

AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and breast-feeding women. AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children weighing less than 45 kg. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

Common side effects of taking AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET are stomach cramps, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, dizziness, headache, and/or skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Key Composition

  • Each tablet contains Azithromycin 500 mg

Uses Of AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET

Manages:

  • mild to moderately susceptible infections caused by bacteria and other microorganisms, which include chest, throat, and nasal infections
  • ear infections and skin and soft tissue infections (such as an abscess or boil) in affected individuals

How AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET Works

1. Entry Into the Body

After intake, the active ingredient azithromycin is absorbed and enters the bloodstream, where it begins circulating to different tissues.

2. Accumulation at the Site of Concern

Azithromycin has a unique ability to reach high concentrations inside cells, especially in areas where the body’s natural defense cells are active. This helps the medicine stay effective for a longer duration.

3. Targeting Bacterial Protein Synthesis

Azithromycin selectively attaches to the 50S ribosomal subunit of bacteria.
This ribosomal unit is responsible for building essential proteins that bacteria need for:

  • Cellular structure
  • Growth
  • Survival

4. Blocking the Assembly of New Proteins

Once attached, azithromycin blocks the translocation step in bacterial protein assembly.
This step is crucial for adding new amino acids to the growing protein chain.

5. Halting Bacterial Growth

Because the bacteria are unable to produce vital proteins:

  • Their growth slows down
  • Their ability to multiply reduces
  • Their internal processes gradually weaken

6. Extended Action Due to Long Half-Life

Azithromycin remains in tissues for a prolonged period, providing an extended duration of activity even after the dosing schedule is completed.

7. Support for the Body’s Natural Defense System

As the bacterial activity reduces, the body’s natural immune processes find it easier to manage and clear the weakened microorganisms over time.

How to use AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET

  • Azithral 500 mg Tablet is generally taken orally with a full glass of water. Swallow the tablet whole without crushing, chewing, or breaking it, as doing so may affect how the tablet dissolves.
  • It is usually taken once a day at the same time to help maintain a consistent routine.

Recommended Dosage of Azithral 500 mg

  • The dosage schedule for Azithral 500 mg is typically based on age, body needs, and individual health factors. Adults are commonly advised a once-daily dosing pattern, but the overall number of days may vary based on the guidance provided.
  • It is important to follow the prescribed duration and complete the full course, even if you feel better midway.
  • Do not increase or decrease the number of tablets on your own, and do not modify the duration unless advised by a qualified professional.

Responsible usage matters because:

Educational initiatives encourage individuals to check the necessity of antibiotics, avoid self-medicating, and rely on qualified guidance.

FAQs About AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET

Q: What is AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET used for?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET is used to manage mild to moderately susceptible infections caused by bacteria and other microorganisms, which include chest, throat, and nasal infections (such as bronchitis, pneumonia, tonsillitis, sore throat, and sinusitis). It is also used to manage ear infections and skin and soft tissue infections (such as an abscess/boil).

Q: How AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET works?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis (essential for the bacteria to grow) that results in its destruction, thus managing its growth and spread of infection in affected individuals.

Q: What are the most common side effects of taking AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET?

A: The most common side effects of taking AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET are stomach cramps, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, dizziness, headache, and/or skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Q: How to take AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET?

A: Take this medicine as advised by your physician. For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Q: Who should avoid taking AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Azithromycin, other antibiotics such as erythromycin/clarithromycin (macrolides), and/or ketolides. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from liver diseases such as cholestatic jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Q: Is AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET available over the counter?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET is usually available by prescription only. It is important to consult with a healthcare provider before starting management with AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET.

Q: Can AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET be taken with food?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET can be taken with or without food. However, taking it with food may help reduce the risk of gastrointestinal side effects such as nausea and stomach upset.

Q: Can AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET cause drowsiness?

A: Drowsiness is not a common side effect of AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET. However, some individuals may experience dizziness or fatigue while taking the medication. If you experience any significant drowsiness or dizziness, avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how the medication affects you.

Q: Can AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET be used for dental infections?

A: AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET may be prescribed by a healthcare provider to manage certain dental infections caused by bacteria. However, the appropriateness of AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET for dental infections should be determined by a healthcare provider based on the specific circumstances of the infection.

Q: Can AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET be used to manage viral infections such as the common cold or flu?

A: No. AZITHRAL 500MG TABLET belongs to antibiotics and are only effective against bacterial infections. They will not work for viral infections such as the common cold or flu.
